metadata.name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022
metadata.description: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 is the international standard for Information Security Management Systems (ISMS). It specifies requirements for establishing, implementing, maintaining, and continually improving an ISMS within the context of the organization. The 2022 revision restructured the Annex A controls into 4 themes with 93 controls total, replacing the previous 14-domain structure with 114 controls.
metadata.source_organization: International Organization for Standardization (ISO) / International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC)
metadata.classification_reasoning: ISO 27001 is a certification framework requiring formal audits by accredited Certification Bodies (CBs) under accreditation bodies such as UKAS, ANAB, or JAS-ANZ. Organizations achieve certification through Stage 1 (documentation review) and Stage 2 (implementation audit) assessments.
metadata.framework_purpose: To provide requirements for establishing, implementing, maintaining, and continually improving an information security management system (ISMS), ensuring the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information assets through a risk-based approach.
metadata.framework_scope: Applicable to all types and sizes of organizations seeking to establish and maintain an ISMS, manage information security risks, and demonstrate conformity to information security requirements.
framework_objectives: Establish a systematic approach to managing sensitive company information
Ensure confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information
Achieve continuous improvement of the ISMS
Demonstrate compliance with legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements
metadata.target_audience: CISOs, Information Security Managers, IT Governance Teams, Risk Managers, Compliance Officers, Internal Auditors, and Senior Management responsible for information security
metadata.certification_body: Accredited Certification Bodies (e.g., BSI, Bureau Veritas, TÜV, DNV, SGS, Schellman)
metadata.penalty_for_non_compliance: Loss of certification, reputational damage, potential loss of business contracts requiring ISO 27001 certification, and inability to demonstrate due diligence in information security management.
adoption_approach: Conduct internal audits and management reviews
Engage accredited CB for Stage 1 and Stage 2 audits
Maintain through surveillance audits and continual improvement

controls.title: Policies for Information Security
controls.description: A set of policies for information security shall be defined, approved by management, published, communicated to and acknowledged by relevant personnel and relevant interested parties, and reviewed at planned intervals or if significant changes occur.
controls.full_text: Information security policy and topic-specific policies shall be defined, approved by management, published, communicated to and acknowledged by relevant personnel and relevant interested parties. The policies shall be reviewed at planned intervals or if significant changes occur to ensure their continuing suitability, adequacy, and effectiveness. Policies should address the organization's approach to managing information security objectives.

evidence_requirements.name: Information Security Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Master ISMS policy document signed and dated by top management, stating objectives, scope, and commitments.

evidence_requirements.name: Topic-Specific Policies Register
evidence_requirements.description: Index of all subordinate policies (access control, crypto, backup, etc.) with owners, version numbers, and review dates.

evidence_requirements.name: Policy Approval Record
evidence_requirements.description: Board or management meeting minutes or e-signature record approving issuance of each policy version.

evidence_requirements.name: Policy Acknowledgement Log
evidence_requirements.description: HR or LMS export showing each employee acknowledged the current policy, with timestamps.

evidence_requirements.name: Policy Communication Evidence
evidence_requirements.description: Intranet screenshot, email announcement, or town hall deck confirming communication to staff and interested parties.

evidence_requirements.name: Annual Policy Review Minutes
evidence_requirements.description: Minutes of the scheduled policy review showing changes considered, approval, and next review date.

controls.title: Information Security Roles and Responsibilities
controls.description: Information security roles and responsibilities shall be defined and allocated. All information security responsibilities shall be clearly defined and allocated to ensure proper implementation and operation of the ISMS.
controls.full_text: Information security roles and responsibilities shall be defined and allocated according to the organization's needs. This includes defining responsibilities for the protection of individual assets and for carrying out specific information security processes. Responsibilities for information security risk management activities and acceptance of residual risks shall be defined. The allocation shall be documented and communicated.

evidence_requirements.name: Information Security RACI Matrix
evidence_requirements.description: Matrix mapping security activities (risk mgmt, incident response, audit, etc.) to roles marked R/A/C/I.

evidence_requirements.name: Security Role Job Descriptions
evidence_requirements.description: Job descriptions for CISO, ISMS Manager, Security Analysts and asset owners explicitly listing security duties.

evidence_requirements.name: Organisational Chart with Security Function
evidence_requirements.description: Org chart showing reporting lines for the security function and independence from IT operations.

evidence_requirements.name: Residual Risk Acceptance Records
evidence_requirements.description: Signed acceptance forms showing named risk owners have formally accepted residual risks.

evidence_requirements.name: Security Responsibilities Appointment Letters
evidence_requirements.description: Letters or e-appointments formally assigning security roles (e.g., CISO, DPO, ISO).

controls.title: Segregation of Duties
controls.description: Conflicting duties and conflicting areas of responsibility shall be segregated to reduce opportunities for unauthorized or unintentional modification or misuse of the organization's assets.
controls.full_text: Conflicting duties and areas of responsibility shall be segregated to reduce opportunities for unauthorized or unintentional modification or misuse of the organization's assets. No single person should be able to access, modify, or use assets without authorization or detection. The initiation of an event should be separated from its authorization. The possibility of collusion should be considered in designing segregation controls.

evidence_requirements.name: Segregation of Duties Matrix
evidence_requirements.description: Matrix of conflicting activities (e.g., request vs approve, develop vs deploy) with enforcement approach per system.

evidence_requirements.name: SoD Ruleset Configuration Export
evidence_requirements.description: Export from ERP/IAM (e.g., SAP GRC, SailPoint) showing configured SoD rules and violations.

evidence_requirements.name: SoD Violation and Remediation Report
evidence_requirements.description: Periodic report listing detected SoD conflicts, owners, mitigation status and sign-off.

evidence_requirements.name: Compensating Controls Documentation
evidence_requirements.description: Documented compensating controls where full SoD is not feasible (e.g., independent review of sensitive transactions).

evidence_requirements.name: Privileged Action Review Log
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of dual-control or four-eyes approval for high-risk operational changes.

controls.title: Management Responsibilities
controls.description: Management shall require all personnel to apply information security in accordance with the established information security policy and topic-specific policies and procedures of the organization.
controls.full_text: Management shall require all personnel to apply information security in accordance with the established information security policy and topic-specific policies and procedures of the organization. Management responsibilities include ensuring that personnel are properly briefed on their information security roles before being granted access, are provided with guidelines stating information security expectations, achieve a level of awareness relevant to their roles, and conform to the terms and conditions of employment.

evidence_requirements.name: Management Commitment Statement
evidence_requirements.description: Signed leadership statement committing to enforce security policies and providing resources.

evidence_requirements.name: New Joiner Security Briefing Record
evidence_requirements.description: Induction attendance or checklist signed by new hires confirming security briefing before access.

evidence_requirements.name: Employment Contract Security Clauses
evidence_requirements.description: Sample redacted contract showing security and confidentiality clauses in T&Cs of employment.

evidence_requirements.name: Manager Security Expectations Guidelines
evidence_requirements.description: Guidance document issued to line managers outlining how to enforce policies in their teams.

evidence_requirements.name: Management Review Meeting Minutes
evidence_requirements.description: Minutes demonstrating management review of ISMS performance and directives to staff.

controls.title: Contact with Authorities
controls.description: The organization shall establish and maintain contact with relevant authorities such as law enforcement, regulatory bodies, and supervisory authorities.
controls.full_text: Appropriate contacts with relevant authorities shall be maintained. The organization should have procedures in place that specify when and by whom authorities should be contacted (e.g., law enforcement, fire departments, supervisory authorities) and how identified information security incidents should be reported in a timely manner. Contact with authorities is also relevant for incident response, business continuity, and compliance with legal and regulatory requirements.

evidence_requirements.name: Authorities Contact Register
evidence_requirements.description: Register of relevant authorities (CERT, police, data protection regulator, fire service) with phone, email and named contacts.

evidence_requirements.name: Authority Escalation Procedure
evidence_requirements.description: Procedure stating triggers, timings and approvers for contacting each authority.

evidence_requirements.name: Regulatory Breach Notification Template
evidence_requirements.description: Pre-drafted notification template aligned with statutory reporting windows (e.g., 72 hours).

evidence_requirements.name: Records of Authority Communications
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of past or tabletop communications with authorities, e.g., incident reports filed with CERT.

evidence_requirements.name: Annual Contact Verification Record
evidence_requirements.description: Annual confirmation that contact details remain current (call/email verification log).

controls.title: Contact with Special Interest Groups
controls.description: The organization shall establish and maintain contact with special interest groups or other specialist security forums and professional associations.
controls.full_text: Appropriate contacts with special interest groups or other specialist security forums and professional associations shall be maintained. Membership in special interest groups or forums should be considered as a means to receive early warnings of alerts, advisories, and patches. These contacts provide access to specialized information security advice and serve as liaison points for information security incident coordination.

evidence_requirements.name: Special Interest Groups Register
evidence_requirements.description: List of memberships in ISACs, CERTs, vendor security forums, ISACA, (ISC)², OWASP chapters, etc.

evidence_requirements.name: Membership Invoices/Certificates
evidence_requirements.description: Proof of active membership and dues payment for current period.

evidence_requirements.name: Threat Advisory Distribution Log
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence that advisories received from SIGs are disseminated to relevant internal teams.

evidence_requirements.name: Conference/Forum Attendance Records
evidence_requirements.description: Certificates or attendance logs from security conferences and specialist forums.

evidence_requirements.name: Intelligence Sharing MoU
evidence_requirements.description: Memorandum of Understanding or NDA signed with intelligence sharing partners.

controls.title: Threat Intelligence
controls.description: Information relating to information security threats shall be collected and analyzed to produce threat intelligence for the organization.
controls.full_text: Information relating to information security threats shall be collected and analyzed to produce threat intelligence. This is a new control in ISO 27001:2022. The organization should establish processes for gathering, analyzing, and disseminating threat intelligence from multiple sources including government agencies, industry groups, vendors, and commercial threat feeds. Threat intelligence should be integrated into risk management and security operations processes.

evidence_requirements.name: Threat Intelligence Procedure
evidence_requirements.description: Documented process for collecting, analysing, disseminating and retiring threat intel.

evidence_requirements.name: Threat Intelligence Sources Inventory
evidence_requirements.description: Register of TI feeds (commercial, OSINT, ISAC, government) with coverage, frequency and cost.

evidence_requirements.name: Threat Landscape Report
evidence_requirements.description: Periodic analyst-produced report on threats relevant to the organisation's sector and assets.

evidence_requirements.name: TI Platform Dashboard Screenshot
evidence_requirements.description: Screenshot of TIP/SIEM (e.g., MISP, Anomali, ThreatConnect) showing active indicators and feeds.

evidence_requirements.name: IOC Ingestion Log
evidence_requirements.description: Log of indicators pushed to SIEM, EDR, firewalls, with correlation results.

evidence_requirements.name: Threat Brief Distribution Record
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of regular threat briefings delivered to leadership and SOC teams.

controls.title: Information Security in Project Management
controls.description: Information security shall be integrated into project management regardless of the type of the project.
controls.full_text: Information security shall be integrated into project management to ensure information security risks are addressed as part of project management. This applies to any type of project regardless of its nature. Project management methodologies should require that information security objectives are identified, information security risks are assessed and treated, information security requirements and controls are incorporated into project deliverables, and information security is reviewed at defined project milestones.

evidence_requirements.name: Project Management Methodology with Security Gates
evidence_requirements.description: PM methodology (e.g., PRINCE2/Agile) explicitly integrating security checkpoints and gate criteria.

evidence_requirements.name: Project Security Risk Assessment Template
evidence_requirements.description: Template used at project initiation to assess information security risks.

evidence_requirements.name: Sample Project Charter with Security Requirements
evidence_requirements.description: Redacted charter from a real project showing security objectives and owners captured upfront.

evidence_requirements.name: Project Security Sign-off Records
evidence_requirements.description: Gate review sign-offs (design, go-live) confirming security reviews completed.

evidence_requirements.name: Project Portfolio Security Tracker
evidence_requirements.description: Register of active projects with security assessment status and outstanding actions.

controls.title: Inventory of Information and Other Associated Assets
controls.description: An inventory of information and other associated assets, including owners, shall be developed and maintained.
controls.full_text: An inventory of information and other associated assets, including owners, shall be developed and maintained. The inventory should include all information assets necessary for the organization to operate and achieve its objectives. Asset owners shall be assigned responsibility for the proper management of assets throughout their lifecycle. The inventory should be accurate, up to date, consistent, and aligned with other inventories.

evidence_requirements.name: Information Asset Register
evidence_requirements.description: Master inventory of information assets with owner, classification, location, custodian and retention.

evidence_requirements.name: Hardware and Software Asset Inventory
evidence_requirements.description: CMDB export or asset management tool report listing all ICT assets with tags and owners.

evidence_requirements.name: Asset Discovery Scan Report
evidence_requirements.description: Automated asset discovery scan output (e.g., Lansweeper, Axonius) reconciled against CMDB.

evidence_requirements.name: Asset Owner Assignment Record
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of formal asset ownership assignments and acknowledgements.

evidence_requirements.name: Inventory Review and Reconciliation Log
evidence_requirements.description: Periodic review log showing assets added, retired and verified.

evidence_requirements.name: Cloud Resource Inventory
evidence_requirements.description: Export from cloud CSPM tool (AWS Config, Azure Resource Graph) listing cloud assets.

controls.title: Acceptable Use of Information and Other Associated Assets
controls.description: Rules for the acceptable use of information and other associated assets shall be identified, documented, and implemented.
controls.full_text: Rules for the acceptable use of information and other associated assets shall be identified, documented, and implemented. Personnel and external party users using or having access to the organization's information and other associated assets shall be made aware of the information security requirements for use. They should be responsible for their use of any information processing resources and any such use carried out under their responsibility.

evidence_requirements.name: Acceptable Use Policy (AUP)
evidence_requirements.description: Policy defining permitted and prohibited uses of IT resources, email, internet and data.

evidence_requirements.name: AUP Acknowledgement Records
evidence_requirements.description: Signed or e-acknowledged AUP records from employees and contractors.

evidence_requirements.name: User Warning/Violation Records
evidence_requirements.description: Records of AUP violations detected and actions taken (redacted).

evidence_requirements.name: AUP Training Module Completion Report
evidence_requirements.description: LMS report showing AUP training module completion by staff.

evidence_requirements.name: System Login Banner Screenshot
evidence_requirements.description: Screenshot of login banner reminding users of acceptable use obligations.

controls.title: Return of Assets
controls.description: Personnel and other interested parties as appropriate shall return all the organization's assets in their possession upon change or termination of their employment, contract, or agreement.
controls.full_text: All organizational assets in the possession of personnel and other interested parties shall be returned upon change or termination of their employment, contract, or agreement. The termination process should be formalized to include the return of all previously issued physical and electronic assets. Where personnel or external party users use personal equipment, procedures should ensure that all relevant information is transferred to the organization and securely deleted from the equipment.

evidence_requirements.name: Asset Return Checklist
evidence_requirements.description: Standard checklist for leavers listing all asset types to be returned (laptop, badge, tokens, mobile).

evidence_requirements.name: Completed Leaver Asset Return Forms
evidence_requirements.description: Signed return forms from recent leavers showing each asset returned and confirmed.

evidence_requirements.name: Offboarding Workflow Screenshot
evidence_requirements.description: Ticket/workflow evidence (e.g., ServiceNow) of offboarding tasks including asset recovery.

evidence_requirements.name: Leavers vs Returns Reconciliation Report
evidence_requirements.description: Periodic reconciliation between HR leavers list and assets recovered.

evidence_requirements.name: BYOD Data Wipe Certificate
evidence_requirements.description: MDM-issued certificate of selective wipe for personal devices used for work.

controls.title: Classification of Information
controls.description: Information shall be classified according to the information security needs of the organization based on confidentiality, integrity, availability, and relevant interested party requirements.
controls.full_text: Information shall be classified in terms of legal requirements, value, criticality, and sensitivity to unauthorized disclosure or modification. The classification scheme should include conventions for classification and criteria for review of classification over time. The level of protection should be assessed by analyzing confidentiality, integrity, and availability requirements and any other requirements for the information considered, taking account of business needs for sharing or restricting information.

evidence_requirements.name: Information Classification Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Policy defining classification levels (e.g., Public, Internal, Confidential, Restricted) and handling rules.

evidence_requirements.name: Classification Scheme and Handling Matrix
evidence_requirements.description: Matrix mapping each classification level to storage, transmission, retention and disposal rules.

evidence_requirements.name: Classified Asset Inventory Extract
evidence_requirements.description: Sample extract from asset register showing classification values assigned.

evidence_requirements.name: Classification Training Materials
evidence_requirements.description: Training deck used to teach staff how to classify information correctly.

evidence_requirements.name: Reclassification Review Log
evidence_requirements.description: Log of periodic reviews where classifications were reassessed and adjusted.

controls.title: Labelling of Information
controls.description: An appropriate set of procedures for information labelling shall be developed and implemented in accordance with the information classification scheme adopted by the organization.
controls.full_text: An appropriate set of procedures for information labelling shall be developed and implemented in accordance with the information classification scheme adopted by the organization. Procedures for information labelling should cover information and associated assets in physical and electronic formats. The labelling should reflect the classification scheme established. Labels should be easily recognizable and managed throughout the information lifecycle.

evidence_requirements.name: Information Labelling Procedure
evidence_requirements.description: Procedure specifying how to label electronic and physical information per classification.

evidence_requirements.name: Document Label Templates
evidence_requirements.description: Templates (Word/PowerPoint headers-footers, watermarks) used to apply classification labels.

evidence_requirements.name: MIP/Labelling Tool Configuration
evidence_requirements.description: Screenshot of Microsoft Purview / Titus / Boldon James sensitivity labels and auto-labelling rules.

evidence_requirements.name: Physical Label Examples
evidence_requirements.description: Photos of physical media (folders, tapes, removable drives) with applied classification labels.

evidence_requirements.name: Label Coverage Report
evidence_requirements.description: Report showing percentage of documents/emails labelled correctly over time.

controls.title: Information Transfer
controls.description: Information transfer rules, procedures, or agreements shall be in place for all types of transfer facilities within the organization and between the organization and other parties.
controls.full_text: Information transfer rules, procedures, or agreements shall be in place for all types of transfer facilities within the organization and between the organization and other parties. Rules, procedures, and agreements should address the protection of transferred information from interception, unauthorized access, copying, modification, misrouting, and destruction. Procedures and controls to protect information transfer should reflect the classification of information involved.

evidence_requirements.name: Information Transfer Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Policy defining authorised transfer methods, encryption requirements and approvals.

evidence_requirements.name: Secure Transfer Procedures
evidence_requirements.description: Procedures for specific methods: SFTP, secure email, encrypted USB, managed file transfer.

evidence_requirements.name: Data Transfer Agreement Templates
evidence_requirements.description: Standard transfer agreement / data sharing agreement templates used with third parties.

evidence_requirements.name: MFT Platform Transfer Log
evidence_requirements.description: Log export from managed file transfer platform showing encrypted transfers and recipients.

evidence_requirements.name: Email Encryption Configuration
evidence_requirements.description: Screenshot of TLS/S-MIME/PGP configuration enforcing encrypted external mail flows.

evidence_requirements.name: Courier Chain-of-Custody Receipts
evidence_requirements.description: Signed receipts for physical media transfers via approved couriers.

controls.title: Access Control
controls.description: Rules to control physical and logical access to information and other associated assets shall be established and implemented based on business and information security requirements.
controls.full_text: Rules to control physical and logical access to information and other associated assets shall be established and implemented based on business and information security requirements. Access control rules should consider the business application requirements and be consistent with the applicable access control policy. Access control should take into account the principle of least privilege and need-to-know, with appropriate segregation of duties.

evidence_requirements.name: Access Control Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Topic-specific policy defining principles (least privilege, need-to-know) and scope.

evidence_requirements.name: Logical Access Rules Standard
evidence_requirements.description: Standard defining authentication, authorisation and session rules for each system type.

evidence_requirements.name: Role-Based Access Matrix
evidence_requirements.description: Matrix mapping roles to permitted functions in key business applications.

evidence_requirements.name: Physical Access Rules Documentation
evidence_requirements.description: Rules and zoning document for physical areas (offices, data centre, restricted labs).

evidence_requirements.name: Access Review Evidence
evidence_requirements.description: Quarterly access review results signed off by data/system owners.

controls.title: Identity Management
controls.description: The full lifecycle of identities shall be managed, including registration, provisioning, administration, and deprovisioning of user identities.
controls.full_text: The full lifecycle of identities shall be managed. This includes the initial registration and provisioning of unique user identifiers, the administration and maintenance of identity information, and the timely deprovisioning or removal of identities that are no longer required. The identity management process should ensure that each user has a unique identifier and that shared identities are only approved where operationally necessary.

evidence_requirements.name: Identity Lifecycle Procedure
evidence_requirements.description: Procedure for joiner-mover-leaver (JML) handling of identities end-to-end.

evidence_requirements.name: IAM System Configuration Screenshot
evidence_requirements.description: Screenshot of IdP (Entra ID, Okta) showing unique ID policy and lifecycle rules.

evidence_requirements.name: User Provisioning Ticket Samples
evidence_requirements.description: Sample tickets showing approval, provisioning and closure for recent onboardings.

evidence_requirements.name: Deprovisioning Log
evidence_requirements.description: Log showing timely disablement of accounts within SLA after termination.

evidence_requirements.name: Shared Account Register
evidence_requirements.description: Register of approved shared/service accounts with justification and owner.

evidence_requirements.name: Dormant Account Report
evidence_requirements.description: Periodic report identifying inactive accounts and remediation taken.

controls.title: Authentication Information
controls.description: Allocation and management of authentication information shall be controlled by a management process including advising personnel on appropriate handling of authentication information.
controls.full_text: Allocation and management of authentication information shall be controlled by a management process. Users should be required to follow good security practices in the selection and use of passwords. Temporary authentication information should be unique to an individual and should not be guessable. Users should acknowledge receipt of authentication information. Default vendor authentication information should be altered after installation.

evidence_requirements.name: Authentication and Password Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Policy specifying password complexity, length, rotation, MFA scope and storage rules.

evidence_requirements.name: Password Policy Configuration Export
evidence_requirements.description: GPO / Entra ID / Okta export showing enforced password and lockout settings.

evidence_requirements.name: MFA Enrolment Report
evidence_requirements.description: Report of MFA enrolment coverage across users, including privileged accounts.

evidence_requirements.name: Temporary Credentials Issuance Log
evidence_requirements.description: Log of temporary/initial credentials issued, delivered securely and forced-changed on first use.

evidence_requirements.name: Default Credentials Change Evidence
evidence_requirements.description: Checklist and sign-off confirming vendor defaults changed on new systems.

evidence_requirements.name: Password Vault Configuration
evidence_requirements.description: Screenshot of password manager / PAM vault configuration and access controls.

controls.title: Access Rights
controls.description: Access rights to information and other associated assets shall be provisioned, reviewed, modified, and removed in accordance with the organization's topic-specific policy on and rules for access control.
controls.full_text: Access rights to information and other associated assets shall be provisioned, reviewed, modified, and removed in accordance with the organization's topic-specific policy on and rules for access control. Access rights should be aligned with defined access control policies and rules. A formal user access provisioning process should be implemented to assign or revoke access rights for all user types to all systems and services. Access rights of users should be reviewed at regular intervals.

evidence_requirements.name: Access Provisioning Workflow Screenshots
evidence_requirements.description: ServiceNow/Jira workflow screenshots showing request-approve-provision steps.

evidence_requirements.name: Periodic Access Review Report
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of completed access recertification (quarterly/bi-annual) signed by managers.

evidence_requirements.name: Access Modification Log
evidence_requirements.description: Audit log showing role changes processed for movers with approvals.

evidence_requirements.name: Access Removal SLA Report
evidence_requirements.description: Metrics showing access removed within target SLA for leavers.

evidence_requirements.name: Privileged Access Request Records
evidence_requirements.description: PAM platform records showing just-in-time privileged access requests and approvals.

evidence_requirements.name: Exception Register for Access
evidence_requirements.description: Register of approved access exceptions with expiry and compensating controls.

controls.title: Information Security in Supplier Relationships
controls.description: Processes and procedures shall be defined and implemented to manage the information security risks associated with the use of supplier's products or services.
controls.full_text: Processes and procedures shall be defined and implemented to manage the information security risks associated with the use of supplier's products or services. The organization should identify and impose information security requirements for mitigating the risks associated with supplier's access to the organization's information and information processing facilities. These requirements should be agreed with each supplier that may access, process, store, communicate, or provide IT infrastructure components for the organization's information.

evidence_requirements.name: Supplier Information Security Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Policy setting security expectations for all supplier categories.

evidence_requirements.name: Supplier Risk Assessment Procedure
evidence_requirements.description: Procedure for onboarding due diligence based on supplier tier and data access.

evidence_requirements.name: Supplier Register
evidence_requirements.description: Register of suppliers with tier, data accessed, last assessment date and risk rating.

evidence_requirements.name: Supplier Security Questionnaire Responses
evidence_requirements.description: Completed due diligence questionnaires (e.g., SIG Lite, CAIQ) from critical suppliers.

evidence_requirements.name: Supplier Certifications Collected
evidence_requirements.description: SOC 2, ISO 27001 or equivalent certificates collected from key suppliers.

controls.title: Addressing Information Security Within Supplier Agreements
controls.description: Relevant information security requirements shall be established and agreed with each supplier based on the type of supplier relationship.
controls.full_text: Relevant information security requirements shall be established and agreed with each supplier based on the type of supplier relationship. Agreements with suppliers should include requirements to address the information security risks associated with information and communications technology services and product supply chain. The agreement should include obligations for the supplier to report information security incidents and vulnerabilities.

evidence_requirements.name: Supplier Contract Security Clause Library
evidence_requirements.description: Library of standard security clauses and DPA templates used in supplier contracts.

evidence_requirements.name: Signed Supplier Agreements
evidence_requirements.description: Executed supplier contracts (redacted) showing information security and incident reporting clauses.

evidence_requirements.name: Supplier NDAs
evidence_requirements.description: Signed non-disclosure agreements with suppliers having access to confidential information.

evidence_requirements.name: Right-to-Audit Clause Evidence
evidence_requirements.description: Extracts showing right-to-audit and subprocessor approval rights included in agreements.

evidence_requirements.name: Contract Compliance Tracker
evidence_requirements.description: Tracker showing which suppliers have updated contracts with current security clauses.

controls.title: Managing Information Security in the ICT Supply Chain
controls.description: Processes and procedures shall be defined and implemented for managing information security risks associated with the ICT products and services supply chain.
controls.full_text: Processes and procedures shall be defined and implemented for managing information security risks associated with the ICT products and services supply chain. This is a new control in ISO 27001:2022. Requirements relating to information security should be included in agreements with ICT suppliers. The ICT supply chain includes cloud computing services, outsourced development, hardware and software suppliers, and managed service providers.

evidence_requirements.name: ICT Supply Chain Risk Management Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Policy addressing risks from hardware, software and cloud vendors across the supply chain.

evidence_requirements.name: Vendor Due Diligence Reports
evidence_requirements.description: Completed due diligence assessments for ICT vendors, including financial and security review.

evidence_requirements.name: SBOM Request and Review Records
evidence_requirements.description: Software Bill of Materials received from vendors and analysis of components.

evidence_requirements.name: Supply Chain Risk Register
evidence_requirements.description: Risk register tracking supply chain risks (4th-party, geo-political, single points of failure).

evidence_requirements.name: Supplier Security Audit Reports
evidence_requirements.description: Audit or assurance reports (SOC 2 Type II, penetration test summaries) from ICT suppliers.

evidence_requirements.name: Critical Vendor Contingency Plan
evidence_requirements.description: Plans for replacing or mitigating loss of critical ICT suppliers.

controls.title: Monitoring, Review, and Change Management of Supplier Services
controls.description: The organization shall regularly monitor, review, evaluate, and manage change in supplier information security practices and service delivery.
controls.full_text: The organization shall regularly monitor, review, evaluate, and manage change in supplier information security practices and service delivery. Monitoring and review of supplier services should ensure that information security terms and conditions of agreements are adhered to, and that information security incidents and problems are managed properly. This should involve a service management relationship between the organization and the supplier.

evidence_requirements.name: Supplier Performance Review Reports
evidence_requirements.description: Periodic supplier review reports covering SLA, security KPIs and incidents.

evidence_requirements.name: SLA Compliance Dashboard
evidence_requirements.description: Dashboard or report showing SLA attainment across key suppliers.

evidence_requirements.name: Supplier Audit Reports
evidence_requirements.description: On-site or remote supplier audit reports and management responses.

evidence_requirements.name: Supplier Change Notification Records
evidence_requirements.description: Emails or portal notifications of material changes to supplier services and impact assessment.

evidence_requirements.name: Supplier Meeting Minutes
evidence_requirements.description: Minutes of regular governance/service review meetings with suppliers.

evidence_requirements.name: Supplier Scorecard
evidence_requirements.description: Balanced scorecard rating suppliers across security, performance and compliance.

controls.title: Information Security for Use of Cloud Services
controls.description: Processes for acquisition, use, management, and exit from cloud services shall be established in accordance with the organization's information security requirements.
controls.full_text: Processes for acquisition, use, management, and exit from cloud services shall be established in accordance with the organization's information security requirements. This is a new control in ISO 27001:2022. The organization should define requirements for cloud service security including data location, service level agreements, incident management, exit strategy, and encryption requirements. Shared responsibilities between the cloud service provider and the organization should be clearly defined.

evidence_requirements.name: Cloud Security Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Policy covering cloud acquisition, use, data location, encryption and exit requirements.

evidence_requirements.name: Cloud Service Provider Risk Assessment
evidence_requirements.description: Assessment of each major CSP including data residency, certifications and shared responsibility.

evidence_requirements.name: Shared Responsibility Matrix
evidence_requirements.description: Matrix mapping security control ownership between the organisation and the CSP (IaaS/PaaS/SaaS).

evidence_requirements.name: Cloud Exit Strategy
evidence_requirements.description: Documented plan to migrate data and workloads out of each CSP if required.

evidence_requirements.name: Cloud Configuration Baseline
evidence_requirements.description: CIS Benchmark / CSP hardening standard applied (e.g., AWS/Azure/GCP CIS).

evidence_requirements.name: CSPM Scan Results
evidence_requirements.description: Cloud Security Posture Management scan showing misconfigurations and remediation status.

evidence_requirements.name: Cloud Tenant Admin Access Review
evidence_requirements.description: Review report of cloud console admin users and privileged roles.

controls.title: Information Security Incident Management Planning and Preparation
controls.description: The organization shall plan and prepare for managing information security incidents by defining, establishing, and communicating information security incident management processes, roles, and responsibilities.
controls.full_text: The organization shall plan and prepare for managing information security incidents by defining, establishing, and communicating information security incident management processes, roles, and responsibilities. This includes establishing incident response procedures, defining reporting channels, establishing incident response teams, and preparing evidence collection and preservation procedures for potential legal proceedings or disciplinary actions.

evidence_requirements.name: Incident Response Plan
evidence_requirements.description: Documented IRP with phases, roles, escalation paths and communication templates.

evidence_requirements.name: Incident Response Team Charter and Roster
evidence_requirements.description: Charter defining the IR team, contact list and on-call rota.

evidence_requirements.name: Incident Classification Taxonomy
evidence_requirements.description: Severity/category matrix used to triage and classify incidents.

evidence_requirements.name: Incident Communication Templates
evidence_requirements.description: Pre-approved templates for internal, customer, regulator and media communications.

evidence_requirements.name: IR Playbooks
evidence_requirements.description: Playbooks for common scenarios (ransomware, phishing, data exfiltration, DDoS).

evidence_requirements.name: IR Tabletop Exercise Report
evidence_requirements.description: Report from most recent tabletop exercise including participants, scenarios and lessons.

evidence_requirements.name: Forensic Readiness Procedure
evidence_requirements.description: Procedure for evidence collection, chain of custody and forensic tooling.

controls.title: Assessment and Decision on Information Security Events
controls.description: The organization shall assess information security events and decide if they are to be categorized as information security incidents.
controls.full_text: The organization shall assess information security events and decide if they are to be categorized as information security incidents. Each information security event should be assessed and a decision made on whether it meets the agreed definition of an information security incident. The assessment should use an agreed classification scale to determine priority and resource allocation. Events should be correlated and analyzed to identify patterns.

evidence_requirements.name: Event Triage Procedure
evidence_requirements.description: SOC procedure for triaging raw events into categorised incidents.

evidence_requirements.name: Incident Classification Records
evidence_requirements.description: Sample ticket records showing event-to-incident decisions with justification.

evidence_requirements.name: SOC Runbook Extract
evidence_requirements.description: Extract from SOC runbook covering triage decision trees.

evidence_requirements.name: SIEM Use-Case Catalogue
evidence_requirements.description: Catalogue of SIEM use cases with severity mapping for triage.

evidence_requirements.name: Event Assessment Log
evidence_requirements.description: Log export showing events assessed, closed as non-incidents or escalated.

evidence_requirements.name: Incident Correlation Report
evidence_requirements.description: Report showing correlation of related events into single incidents.

controls.title: Response to Information Security Incidents
controls.description: Information security incidents shall be responded to in accordance with the documented procedures.
controls.full_text: Information security incidents shall be responded to in accordance with the documented procedures. The response should include containment of the incident, collection and preservation of evidence, escalation as needed, communication to internal and external stakeholders, documentation of all response activities, and analysis for determining the root cause. Response activities should be logged for subsequent analysis.

evidence_requirements.name: Incident Response Procedures
evidence_requirements.description: Detailed step-by-step procedures for containment, eradication, recovery and closure.

evidence_requirements.name: Incident Ticket Records
evidence_requirements.description: Redacted recent incident tickets showing full response lifecycle with timestamps.

evidence_requirements.name: Incident War-Room Minutes
evidence_requirements.description: Minutes or recordings of incident coordination calls for major incidents.

evidence_requirements.name: Evidence Preservation Records
evidence_requirements.description: Chain-of-custody forms and forensic imaging records for recent incidents.

evidence_requirements.name: Regulator/Customer Notification Records
evidence_requirements.description: Sent notifications to regulators/customers for breaches, with timestamps vs. SLA.

evidence_requirements.name: Post-Incident Report
evidence_requirements.description: Formal post-incident report covering root cause, impact, timeline and remediation.

controls.title: Learning from Information Security Incidents
controls.description: Knowledge gained from information security incidents shall be used to strengthen and improve the information security controls.
controls.full_text: Knowledge gained from information security incidents shall be used to strengthen and improve the information security controls. Mechanisms should be in place to enable the types, volumes, and costs of information security incidents to be quantified and monitored. Lessons learned from incidents should be incorporated into the risk assessment process, awareness training programs, and control improvements. Trends and patterns should be analyzed to prevent recurrence.

evidence_requirements.name: Lessons Learned Report Template
evidence_requirements.description: Standard template for capturing lessons learned after each significant incident.

evidence_requirements.name: Completed Lessons Learned Reports
evidence_requirements.description: Recent lessons learned reports showing identified improvements and owners.

evidence_requirements.name: Incident Metrics and Trends Report
evidence_requirements.description: Quarterly metrics: incident volume, MTTD, MTTR, root cause categories and cost.

evidence_requirements.name: Control Improvement Tracker
evidence_requirements.description: Tracker linking incident lessons to control changes, status and closure evidence.

evidence_requirements.name: Updated Risk Assessment Entries
evidence_requirements.description: Risk register entries updated as a direct result of incidents.

evidence_requirements.name: Awareness Content Updates
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence that awareness/training was updated based on incident themes.

controls.title: Collection of Evidence
controls.description: The organization shall establish and implement procedures for the identification, collection, acquisition, and preservation of evidence related to information security events.
controls.full_text: The organization shall establish and implement procedures for the identification, collection, acquisition, and preservation of evidence related to information security events. Procedures should be developed and followed for evidence collection and handling that comply with legal and regulatory requirements. Evidence should be collected in a manner that ensures its admissibility and integrity. Chain of custody procedures should be implemented.

evidence_requirements.name: Evidence Collection Procedure
evidence_requirements.description: Procedure covering identification, acquisition, preservation, and handling of digital evidence.

evidence_requirements.name: Chain of Custody Form Template
evidence_requirements.description: Standard form for recording custody transfers with timestamps and signatures.

evidence_requirements.name: Forensic Toolkit Inventory
evidence_requirements.description: Inventory of forensic tools in use (EnCase, FTK, Autopsy, Velociraptor) and licence status.

evidence_requirements.name: Completed Chain of Custody Records
evidence_requirements.description: Example completed chain of custody forms from prior incidents.

evidence_requirements.name: Forensic Image Hash Register
evidence_requirements.description: Register of forensic images taken with cryptographic hashes for integrity.

evidence_requirements.name: Forensic Analyst Qualifications
evidence_requirements.description: Certifications (GCFA, GCFE, CCE) of staff or retainer agreement with forensic firm.

controls.title: Information Security During Disruption
controls.description: The organization shall plan how to maintain information security at an appropriate level during disruption.
controls.full_text: The organization shall plan how to maintain information security at an appropriate level during disruption. Information security requirements should be integrated into business continuity management. The organization should determine requirements for information security and the continuity of information security management in adverse situations. Information security continuity should be planned, implemented, and tested as an integral part of business continuity planning.

evidence_requirements.name: Information Security Continuity Plan
evidence_requirements.description: Plan defining how security controls are maintained during disruption.

evidence_requirements.name: Business Continuity Plan with Security Section
evidence_requirements.description: BCP document including explicit information security considerations.

evidence_requirements.name: BIA Including Security Requirements
evidence_requirements.description: Business Impact Analysis identifying security requirements during disruption.

evidence_requirements.name: BCP Test Report
evidence_requirements.description: Most recent BCP test report demonstrating security controls maintained during exercise.

evidence_requirements.name: Alternate Site Security Assessment
evidence_requirements.description: Security assessment of hot/warm/cold alternate recovery sites.

evidence_requirements.name: Continuity Training Records
evidence_requirements.description: Training records for staff with continuity-related security responsibilities.

controls.title: ICT Readiness for Business Continuity
controls.description: ICT readiness shall be planned, implemented, maintained, and tested based on business continuity objectives and ICT continuity requirements.
controls.full_text: ICT readiness shall be planned, implemented, maintained, and tested based on business continuity objectives and ICT continuity requirements. This is a new control in ISO 27001:2022. ICT continuity planning should include identification of critical ICT services and their dependencies, assessment of the risks to ICT continuity, development and implementation of ICT continuity strategies and plans, and regular testing and exercising of ICT continuity arrangements.

evidence_requirements.name: ICT Continuity Plan
evidence_requirements.description: Plan for restoring ICT services within RTO/RPO objectives.

evidence_requirements.name: RTO/RPO Register
evidence_requirements.description: Register of critical ICT services with agreed RTO, RPO and dependencies.

evidence_requirements.name: DR Runbooks
evidence_requirements.description: Technical runbooks for DR failover of each critical system.

evidence_requirements.name: DR Test Results
evidence_requirements.description: Most recent DR test report showing achievement of RTO/RPO targets.

evidence_requirements.name: Critical ICT Services Inventory
evidence_requirements.description: Inventory of critical systems with owners and recovery tiers.

evidence_requirements.name: Failover Architecture Diagram
evidence_requirements.description: Architecture diagram showing redundancy and failover paths.

controls.title: Legal, Statutory, Regulatory, and Contractual Requirements
controls.description: Legal, statutory, regulatory, and contractual requirements relevant to information security and the organization's approach to meet these requirements shall be identified, documented, and kept up to date.
controls.full_text: Legal, statutory, regulatory, and contractual requirements relevant to information security and the organization's approach to meet these requirements shall be identified, documented, and kept up to date. The specific controls and individual responsibilities to meet these requirements should be defined and documented. Management should identify all legislation applicable to the organization, including legislation related to information processing, privacy, and cryptographic controls.

evidence_requirements.name: Legal and Regulatory Obligations Register
evidence_requirements.description: Register of all applicable laws, regulations and contractual obligations with requirements mapped to controls.

evidence_requirements.name: Compliance Obligations Matrix
evidence_requirements.description: Matrix mapping each obligation to responsible owner, controls and evidence.

evidence_requirements.name: Legal Counsel Advisory Records
evidence_requirements.description: Advisory notes from internal/external counsel on new or changed requirements.

evidence_requirements.name: Horizon Scanning Report
evidence_requirements.description: Report of upcoming legislative/regulatory changes and readiness status.

evidence_requirements.name: Cryptographic Controls Legal Review
evidence_requirements.description: Legal review of cryptographic use across jurisdictions (e.g., export controls).

evidence_requirements.name: Compliance Monitoring Reports
evidence_requirements.description: Periodic reports confirming compliance with each major obligation.

controls.title: Intellectual Property Rights
controls.description: The organization shall implement appropriate procedures to protect intellectual property rights.
controls.full_text: The organization shall implement appropriate procedures to ensure compliance with legislative, regulatory, and contractual requirements related to intellectual property rights and use of proprietary software products. This includes software license management, policies on acquisition of software, awareness of intellectual property rights policies, maintaining proof of license ownership, and implementing controls to ensure maximum number of users is not exceeded.

evidence_requirements.name: Software License Inventory
evidence_requirements.description: Inventory of all licensed software with counts, allocation and renewal dates.

evidence_requirements.name: Intellectual Property Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Policy on acquisition, use and protection of IP and proprietary software.

evidence_requirements.name: License Compliance Audit Report
evidence_requirements.description: Internal or vendor-led software asset management audit report.

evidence_requirements.name: Software Acquisition Approval Records
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence that software is procured through approved channels with license verification.

evidence_requirements.name: Open Source License Register
evidence_requirements.description: Register of OSS components in use with licenses (MIT, GPL, Apache) and compliance notes.

evidence_requirements.name: Anti-Piracy Awareness Record
evidence_requirements.description: Awareness communications reminding staff of IP obligations.

controls.title: Protection of Records
controls.description: Records shall be protected from loss, destruction, falsification, unauthorized access, and unauthorized release in accordance with legislative, regulatory, contractual, and business requirements.
controls.full_text: Records shall be protected from loss, destruction, falsification, unauthorized access, and unauthorized release in accordance with legislative, regulatory, contractual, and business requirements. Controls should consider the classification of records, applicable retention periods, permitted storage media, authorized access and handling, and the eventual secure destruction or disposal when retention periods expire.

evidence_requirements.name: Records Management Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Policy on creation, storage, retrieval, protection and disposal of records.

evidence_requirements.name: Records Retention Schedule
evidence_requirements.description: Schedule listing record types, retention period, legal basis and disposal method.

evidence_requirements.name: Records Protection Controls Documentation
evidence_requirements.description: Documentation of storage, encryption and access controls for protected records.

evidence_requirements.name: Records Destruction Log
evidence_requirements.description: Log of records destroyed at end of retention with method and witness.

evidence_requirements.name: Archive Access Logs
evidence_requirements.description: Logs of access to archived records for audit traceability.

evidence_requirements.name: Retention Automation Configuration
evidence_requirements.description: Configuration of retention policies in ECM/email (e.g., Purview retention labels).

controls.title: Privacy and Protection of Personal Identifiable Information (PII)
controls.description: The organization shall identify and meet the requirements regarding the preservation of privacy and protection of PII as required in applicable legislation, regulations, and contractual requirements.
controls.full_text: The organization shall identify and meet the requirements regarding the preservation of privacy and protection of PII as required in applicable legislation and regulations and contractual requirements. A data protection officer or equivalent function should be appointed. Privacy by design and by default principles should be implemented. Processing of PII should be documented including purpose, legal basis, retention periods, and data subject rights procedures.

evidence_requirements.name: Privacy Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Privacy policy describing processing of personal data, rights and contact points.

evidence_requirements.name: Records of Processing Activities (ROPA)
evidence_requirements.description: ROPA documenting purposes, legal basis, categories, retention and transfers.

evidence_requirements.name: Data Protection Impact Assessments
evidence_requirements.description: Completed DPIAs for high-risk processing activities.

evidence_requirements.name: Data Subject Rights Procedure
evidence_requirements.description: Procedure for handling access, rectification, erasure and portability requests.

evidence_requirements.name: DPO Appointment Letter
evidence_requirements.description: Appointment of Data Protection Officer or equivalent function.

evidence_requirements.name: Cross-Border Transfer Mechanisms
evidence_requirements.description: SCCs, BCRs or adequacy decisions evidencing lawful international transfers.

evidence_requirements.name: Consent Management Records
evidence_requirements.description: Records from consent management platform showing valid consent capture.

controls.title: Independent Review of Information Security
controls.description: The organization's approach to managing information security and its implementation including people, processes, and technologies shall be reviewed independently at planned intervals or when significant changes occur.
controls.full_text: The organization's approach to managing information security and its implementation shall be reviewed independently at planned intervals, or when significant changes occur. Independent review should be initiated by management and may be carried out by internal audit functions, independent external parties, or an independent manager. Results of independent reviews should be reported to management and records maintained. Corrective actions should be taken when the independent review identifies that the organization's approach is inadequate.

evidence_requirements.name: Internal Audit Programme
evidence_requirements.description: Multi-year internal audit plan covering all ISMS areas with frequency.

evidence_requirements.name: Internal Audit Reports
evidence_requirements.description: Completed internal audit reports with findings, evidence and recommendations.

evidence_requirements.name: Auditor Independence and Competence Evidence
evidence_requirements.description: Qualifications and independence declaration for internal auditors.

evidence_requirements.name: Management Review of Audit Findings
evidence_requirements.description: Management review minutes reviewing audit results and directing corrective actions.

evidence_requirements.name: Corrective Action Register
evidence_requirements.description: Register of audit-driven corrective actions with owners, due dates and status.

evidence_requirements.name: External Review Reports
evidence_requirements.description: Reports from external advisors or previous CB audits used as independent review.

controls.title: Compliance with Policies, Rules, and Standards for Information Security
controls.description: Compliance with the organization's information security policy, topic-specific policies, rules, and standards shall be regularly reviewed.
controls.full_text: Compliance with the organization's information security policy, topic-specific policies, rules, and standards shall be regularly reviewed. Managers should regularly review the compliance of information processing and procedures within their area of responsibility. If any non-compliance is found as a result of the review, managers should identify causes and evaluate the need for corrective actions. Results of reviews and corrective actions should be recorded and maintained.

evidence_requirements.name: Compliance Review Schedule
evidence_requirements.description: Schedule of manager-led compliance reviews by area (quarterly/semi-annual).

evidence_requirements.name: Compliance Self-Assessment Forms
evidence_requirements.description: Completed self-assessment forms from department managers.

evidence_requirements.name: Non-Compliance Report
evidence_requirements.description: Log of non-compliances detected with root cause and corrective action.

evidence_requirements.name: Compliance Monitoring Dashboard
evidence_requirements.description: Dashboard showing compliance KPI trends across control families.

evidence_requirements.name: Technical Compliance Scan Results
evidence_requirements.description: Automated compliance scan output against internal standards (e.g., Prowler, Chef InSpec).

evidence_requirements.name: Corrective Action Evidence
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of actions taken to address non-compliances.

controls.title: Documented Operating Procedures
controls.description: Operating procedures for information processing facilities shall be documented and made available to personnel who need them.
controls.full_text: Operating procedures for information processing facilities shall be documented and made available to personnel who need them. Documented procedures should be prepared for system activities associated with information processing and communication facilities, such as computer start-up and close-down, backup, equipment maintenance, media handling, computer room and mail handling management, and safety procedures. Operating procedures should specify instructions for detailed execution of each job.

evidence_requirements.name: Operating Procedures Library
evidence_requirements.description: Central library of operating procedures (SOPs) for IT operations activities.

evidence_requirements.name: Procedure Version Control Log
evidence_requirements.description: Version history and review dates for each SOP.

evidence_requirements.name: Procedure Distribution/Acknowledgement Records
evidence_requirements.description: Records showing procedures distributed and acknowledged by operators.

evidence_requirements.name: Runbook Examples
evidence_requirements.description: Operational runbooks for routine activities (backup, patching, restart).

evidence_requirements.name: On-Call Handover Procedure
evidence_requirements.description: Procedure for shift handover and on-call rotation.

evidence_requirements.name: Procedure Review Record
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of periodic review and update of operating procedures.

controls.title: Screening
controls.description: Background verification checks on all candidates to become personnel shall be carried out prior to joining the organization and on an ongoing basis taking into consideration applicable laws, regulations, and ethics and be proportional to the business requirements, the classification of the information to be accessed, and the perceived risks.
controls.full_text: Background verification checks on all candidates to become personnel shall be carried out prior to joining the organization and on an ongoing basis. Screening should take into consideration all relevant privacy, PII protection, and employment legislation. Checks should include character references, verification of CV/resume information, confirmation of academic and professional qualifications, independent identity checks, and credit/criminal records checks where permitted and relevant to the role.

evidence_requirements.name: Background Screening Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Policy defining screening scope by role and jurisdiction, in line with privacy law.

evidence_requirements.name: Background Check Records
evidence_requirements.description: Completed screening reports (criminal, credit, reference, qualification) for new hires.

evidence_requirements.name: Screening Vendor Agreement
evidence_requirements.description: Agreement with background check provider including data protection clauses.

evidence_requirements.name: Screening Tracker
evidence_requirements.description: Tracker of screening status for all hires with completion dates and sign-offs.

evidence_requirements.name: Role-Based Screening Matrix
evidence_requirements.description: Matrix specifying required checks per role tier (standard, elevated, privileged).

evidence_requirements.name: Periodic Re-Screening Records
evidence_requirements.description: Records of periodic re-screening for high-risk roles where legally permitted.

controls.title: Terms and Conditions of Employment
controls.description: The employment contractual agreements shall state the personnel's and the organization's responsibilities for information security.
controls.full_text: The employment contractual agreements shall state the personnel's and the organization's responsibilities for information security. Terms and conditions should include responsibilities for information classification, asset management, information handling, use of IT equipment, internet and email, remote working, and actions in case of disregard of security requirements. Information security roles and responsibilities should extend beyond the organization's premises and normal working hours.

evidence_requirements.name: Standard Employment Contract Template
evidence_requirements.description: Standard contract with security, confidentiality and IP clauses baked in.

evidence_requirements.name: Signed Employee Contracts
evidence_requirements.description: Sample redacted signed contracts showing security obligations.

evidence_requirements.name: Contractor/Third-Party Agreement Template
evidence_requirements.description: Agreement template used for contractors and agency staff with equivalent obligations.

evidence_requirements.name: Confidentiality Agreement (NDA)
evidence_requirements.description: Employee NDA separate from or attached to the employment contract.

evidence_requirements.name: Acceptable Use Acknowledgement
evidence_requirements.description: Employee acknowledgement of AUP captured at onboarding.

evidence_requirements.name: Contract Clause Review Record
evidence_requirements.description: Annual legal review of security clauses in employment documents.

controls.title: Information Security Awareness, Education, and Training
controls.description: Personnel of the organization and relevant interested parties shall receive appropriate information security awareness education and training and regular updates of the organization's information security policy, topic-specific policies, and procedures as relevant for their job function.
controls.full_text: Personnel of the organization and relevant interested parties shall receive appropriate information security awareness education and training and regular updates. The awareness program should include activities such as initial orientation for new employees, regular awareness campaigns, specific training for roles with significant security responsibilities, and updates when policies change. Training should cover the organization's information security policies, personal responsibilities, incident reporting procedures, and consequences of non-compliance.

evidence_requirements.name: Security Awareness Training Plan
evidence_requirements.description: Annual plan covering target audiences, topics, delivery methods and frequency.

evidence_requirements.name: LMS Completion Report
evidence_requirements.description: LMS export showing per-user completion of mandatory training modules.

evidence_requirements.name: Training Content Library
evidence_requirements.description: Training materials (decks, videos, quizzes) used in the awareness programme.

evidence_requirements.name: Phishing Simulation Results
evidence_requirements.description: Reports from phishing simulation tool showing click rates and repeat offenders.

evidence_requirements.name: Role-Based Training Records
evidence_requirements.description: Records for specialised training (developers secure coding, admins PAM, execs exec protection).

evidence_requirements.name: Awareness Campaign Collateral
evidence_requirements.description: Posters, newsletters and intranet articles used in ongoing campaigns.

evidence_requirements.name: Training Effectiveness Metrics
evidence_requirements.description: Metrics showing behavioural change (e.g., incident reporting up, phish clicks down).

controls.title: Disciplinary Process
controls.description: A disciplinary process shall be formalized and communicated to take actions against personnel and other relevant interested parties who have committed an information security policy violation.
controls.full_text: A formal disciplinary process shall be in place and communicated to take action against personnel who have committed an information security breach. The disciplinary process should not be started without prior verification that a security breach has occurred. The formal disciplinary process should ensure correct and fair treatment for personnel who are suspected of committing breaches. It should provide for a graduated response that takes into consideration the nature and gravity of the breach.

evidence_requirements.name: Disciplinary Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Formal disciplinary policy including security violations, fair process and sanctions.

evidence_requirements.name: Disciplinary Process Flowchart
evidence_requirements.description: Flowchart showing stages from investigation to hearing to outcome.

evidence_requirements.name: HR-Security Coordination Procedure
evidence_requirements.description: Procedure describing how Security investigations feed into HR disciplinary action.

evidence_requirements.name: Redacted Disciplinary Case Records
evidence_requirements.description: Redacted case records showing application of the process for security breaches.

evidence_requirements.name: Disciplinary Awareness Communication
evidence_requirements.description: Communication to staff explaining the disciplinary consequences of security breaches.

evidence_requirements.name: Employee Handbook Extract
evidence_requirements.description: Handbook section covering disciplinary process and acknowledgement records.

controls.title: Responsibilities After Termination or Change of Employment
controls.description: Information security responsibilities and duties that remain valid after termination or change of employment shall be defined, enforced, and communicated to relevant personnel and other interested parties.
controls.full_text: Information security responsibilities and duties that remain valid after termination or change of employment shall be defined, enforced, and communicated to relevant personnel and other interested parties. Post-employment obligations should include ongoing confidentiality requirements, return of assets, intellectual property restrictions, and knowledge transfer requirements. Non-compete and non-solicitation clauses should be enforced as applicable. Offboarding procedures should ensure access is revoked.

evidence_requirements.name: Offboarding Checklist
evidence_requirements.description: Comprehensive leaver checklist covering access revocation, asset return and exit briefing.

evidence_requirements.name: Post-Employment Confidentiality Clause
evidence_requirements.description: Contract clauses surviving termination (confidentiality, non-compete where lawful).

evidence_requirements.name: Exit Interview Records
evidence_requirements.description: Exit interview forms covering reminders of continuing obligations.

evidence_requirements.name: Access Revocation Confirmation Log
evidence_requirements.description: Timestamped log confirming access removed from each system on termination.

evidence_requirements.name: Role Change Offboarding Records
evidence_requirements.description: Records showing access rights reviewed/adjusted when staff change roles internally.

evidence_requirements.name: Leaver Reminder Letter Template
evidence_requirements.description: Standard letter sent to leavers reminding of ongoing obligations.

controls.title: Confidentiality or Non-Disclosure Agreements
controls.description: Confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements reflecting the organization's needs for the protection of information shall be identified, documented, regularly reviewed, and signed by personnel and other relevant interested parties.
controls.full_text: Confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements reflecting the organization's needs for the protection of information shall be identified, documented, regularly reviewed, and signed by personnel and other relevant interested parties. NDAs should address the requirement to protect confidential information, the expected duration of the agreement, required actions when an agreement is terminated, responsibilities and actions of signatories to avoid unauthorized information disclosure, and actions expected to be taken in case of a breach.

evidence_requirements.name: NDA Master Template
evidence_requirements.description: Standard NDA template covering duration, scope, breach consequences.

evidence_requirements.name: Signed Employee NDAs
evidence_requirements.description: Repository of signed NDAs from all personnel.

evidence_requirements.name: Third-Party NDA Register
evidence_requirements.description: Register of NDAs signed with contractors, consultants and business partners.

evidence_requirements.name: NDA Legal Review Record
evidence_requirements.description: Annual legal review confirming NDA templates remain enforceable.

evidence_requirements.name: NDA Renewal/Reissue Log
evidence_requirements.description: Log showing NDAs renewed or reissued as scopes or terms change.

evidence_requirements.name: NDA Variant Library
evidence_requirements.description: Variants for specific contexts (mutual, one-way, project-specific).

controls.title: Remote Working
controls.description: Security measures shall be implemented when personnel are working remotely to protect information accessed, processed, or stored outside the organization's premises.
controls.full_text: Security measures shall be implemented when personnel are working remotely to protect information accessed, processed, or stored outside the organization's premises. Remote working arrangements should address physical security of the remote site, communications security, threat of unauthorized access, use of home networks, insurance implications, and the provision of suitable equipment and furniture. Remote working policies should define conditions and restrictions on remote working, including approval requirements and security controls.

evidence_requirements.name: Remote Working Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Policy defining remote working conditions, approvals and security requirements.

evidence_requirements.name: Remote Working Risk Assessment
evidence_requirements.description: Risk assessment covering threats, controls and residual risks for remote working.

evidence_requirements.name: Home Office Security Guidelines
evidence_requirements.description: Guidance issued to staff on securing home work environments.

evidence_requirements.name: VPN/ZTNA Configuration Records
evidence_requirements.description: Secure remote access configuration (VPN, ZTNA) with MFA and encryption evidence.

evidence_requirements.name: Remote Device Configuration Baseline
evidence_requirements.description: Hardening baseline applied to devices used remotely (encryption, endpoint protection).

evidence_requirements.name: Remote Working Agreements
evidence_requirements.description: Signed agreements between employee and organisation covering remote working terms.

evidence_requirements.name: Remote Access Audit Log
evidence_requirements.description: Log of remote access sessions with source IPs, durations and anomaly alerts.

controls.title: Information Security Event Reporting
