controls.description: The organization shall provide a mechanism for personnel to report observed or suspected information security events through appropriate channels in a timely manner.
controls.full_text: The organization shall provide a mechanism for personnel to report observed or suspected information security events through appropriate channels in a timely manner. All personnel and contractors should be made aware of their responsibility to report information security events as quickly as possible. They should be aware of the procedure for reporting information security events and the point of contact to whom events should be reported. Reporting mechanisms should be as easy and accessible as possible.

evidence_requirements.name: Security Event Reporting Procedure
evidence_requirements.description: Procedure telling staff what, how, when and to whom to report security events.

evidence_requirements.name: Reporting Channel Documentation
evidence_requirements.description: Documentation of reporting channels: hotline, portal, email, chat bot.

evidence_requirements.name: Reporting Channel Screenshot
evidence_requirements.description: Screenshot of internal reporting tool (e.g., phish button, ticket portal).

evidence_requirements.name: Event Reporting Awareness Material
evidence_requirements.description: Posters, intranet articles and training content encouraging reporting.

evidence_requirements.name: Event Report Log
evidence_requirements.description: Log of events reported by staff with triage outcomes and metrics on volume.

evidence_requirements.name: Whistleblower / Anonymous Reporting Channel
evidence_requirements.description: Anonymous channel configuration (e.g., third-party hotline) with usage metrics.

controls.title: Physical Security Perimeters
controls.description: Security perimeters shall be defined and used to protect areas that contain information and other associated assets.
controls.full_text: Security perimeters shall be defined and used to protect areas that contain information and other associated assets. Physical protection should be achieved by creating one or more physical barriers around the organization's premises and information processing facilities. The use of the perimeters and the strength of each perimeter should depend on the security requirements of the assets within the perimeter and on the results of a risk assessment.

evidence_requirements.name: Physical Security Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Policy defining security perimeters and zoning principles across facilities.

evidence_requirements.name: Facility Site Plan with Perimeters
evidence_requirements.description: Site/floor plans marked with security zones (public, reception, office, restricted, DC).

evidence_requirements.name: Physical Barrier Specification
evidence_requirements.description: Technical specs for walls, doors, fences, bollards and reception design.

evidence_requirements.name: Perimeter Risk Assessment
evidence_requirements.description: Risk assessment for each perimeter type and residual risk determination.

evidence_requirements.name: Physical Security Survey Report
evidence_requirements.description: Third-party or internal physical security survey of key sites.

evidence_requirements.name: Perimeter Maintenance Records
evidence_requirements.description: Maintenance and inspection records for physical barriers.

controls.title: Physical Entry
controls.description: Secure areas shall be protected by appropriate entry controls and access points to ensure that only authorized personnel are allowed access.
controls.full_text: Secure areas shall be protected by appropriate entry controls and access points to ensure that only authorized personnel are allowed access. Access to areas where information and other associated assets are stored and processed should be controlled and restricted to authorized persons only. Authentication controls should be implemented, such as access cards, PINs, or biometrics. Visitor access should be supervised, and entry/exit times recorded.

evidence_requirements.name: Physical Access Control Procedure
evidence_requirements.description: Procedure for granting, modifying, revoking physical access rights.

evidence_requirements.name: Access Control System Configuration
evidence_requirements.description: Screenshot of PACS (badge system) configuration with zones and schedules.

evidence_requirements.name: Badge Access Log
evidence_requirements.description: PACS log export showing entries/exits with names, timestamps, readers.

evidence_requirements.name: Visitor Management Records
evidence_requirements.description: Visitor log showing registration, escort assignment, badge issue and return.

evidence_requirements.name: Physical Access Review Report
evidence_requirements.description: Periodic review of badge holders confirming continued need.

evidence_requirements.name: Tailgating Awareness Evidence
evidence_requirements.description: Posters, signage and reminders about tailgating/piggybacking.

evidence_requirements.name: Lost/Stolen Badge Report
evidence_requirements.description: Log of lost/stolen badges with deactivation timestamps.

controls.title: Securing Offices, Rooms, and Facilities
controls.description: Physical security for offices, rooms, and facilities shall be designed and implemented.
controls.full_text: Physical security for offices, rooms, and facilities shall be designed and implemented. Key facilities should be sited to avoid access by the public. Buildings should be unobtrusive and give minimum indication of their purpose, where feasible. Facilities should be configured to prevent confidential information or activities from being visible and audible from outside. Directories and internal telephone listings identifying locations of confidential information processing facilities should not be readily accessible.

evidence_requirements.name: Secure Room Design Specification
evidence_requirements.description: Design spec for secure rooms (walls to deck, no external windows, sound attenuation).

evidence_requirements.name: Facility Signage Audit
evidence_requirements.description: Audit confirming no public-facing signage reveals location of sensitive areas.

evidence_requirements.name: Office Layout Privacy Assessment
evidence_requirements.description: Assessment of screen visibility and confidential conversation risk in open offices.

evidence_requirements.name: Key and Combination Management Log
evidence_requirements.description: Log of physical keys and combinations issued, returned and changed.

evidence_requirements.name: Internal Directory Access Restriction
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence that internal phone/floor directories do not expose sensitive locations.

evidence_requirements.name: Secure Area Inspection Report
evidence_requirements.description: Inspection reports of secure office areas for security weaknesses.

controls.title: Physical Security Monitoring
controls.description: Premises shall be continuously monitored for unauthorized physical access.
controls.full_text: Premises shall be continuously monitored for unauthorized physical access. This is a new control in ISO 27001:2022. Monitoring systems should include CCTV, intrusion detection systems, and alarm systems. Monitoring should be designed to detect and deter unauthorized access attempts. Monitoring data should be reviewed regularly and retained according to organizational policies and legal requirements.

evidence_requirements.name: CCTV System Design Documentation
evidence_requirements.description: Design doc covering camera coverage, resolution, retention and monitoring.

evidence_requirements.name: CCTV Coverage Map
evidence_requirements.description: Map showing camera locations and fields of view across facilities.

evidence_requirements.name: Intrusion Detection System Configuration
evidence_requirements.description: IDS/alarm configuration including sensors, zones and response actions.

evidence_requirements.name: Monitoring Alarm Log
evidence_requirements.description: Log of alarms raised, response actions and false-positive analysis.

evidence_requirements.name: Guard Shift Log
evidence_requirements.description: Security guard patrol and incident log entries.

evidence_requirements.name: Monitoring Footage Retention Records
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of retention period compliance and secure storage of footage.

evidence_requirements.name: Privacy Notice for Monitoring
evidence_requirements.description: Notice informing employees/visitors that areas are monitored, as required by law.

controls.title: Protecting Against Physical and Environmental Threats
controls.description: Protection against physical and environmental threats, such as natural disasters and other intentional or unintentional physical threats to infrastructure shall be designed and implemented.
controls.full_text: Protection against physical and environmental threats, such as natural disasters and other intentional or unintentional physical threats to infrastructure, shall be designed and implemented. Physical protection should be designed and applied, taking into account the results of risk assessment. Natural and man-made threats should be considered including fire, flood, earthquake, explosion, civil unrest, and other forms of natural or man-made disaster. Suitable fire detection and suppression systems should be installed.

evidence_requirements.name: Environmental Threat Risk Assessment
evidence_requirements.description: Assessment covering fire, flood, earthquake, power, civil unrest relevant to sites.

evidence_requirements.name: Fire Detection and Suppression Certificates
evidence_requirements.description: Commissioning and annual inspection certificates for fire systems.

evidence_requirements.name: Fire Drill Records
evidence_requirements.description: Records of periodic fire drills with attendance and evaluation.

evidence_requirements.name: Environmental Monitoring Configuration
evidence_requirements.description: BMS configuration for temperature, humidity, leak and smoke monitoring.

evidence_requirements.name: Flood Protection Measures Documentation
evidence_requirements.description: Documentation of flood protection for below-ground or at-risk facilities.

evidence_requirements.name: Environmental Incident Log
evidence_requirements.description: Log of environmental events (alarms, near-misses, actual events) and response.

evidence_requirements.name: Insurance Coverage Evidence
evidence_requirements.description: Certificates of insurance covering environmental risks.

controls.title: Working in Secure Areas
controls.description: Security measures for working in secure areas shall be designed and implemented.
controls.full_text: Security measures for working in secure areas shall be designed and implemented. Controls should consider that personnel should only be aware of the existence of, or activities within, a secure area on a need-to-know basis. Unsupervised working in secure areas should be avoided both for safety reasons and to prevent opportunities for malicious activities. Vacant secure areas should be physically locked and periodically checked.

evidence_requirements.name: Secure Area Working Procedure
evidence_requirements.description: Procedure for personnel working in secure areas (no devices, dual-working, etc.).

evidence_requirements.name: Secure Area Access Register
evidence_requirements.description: Register of personnel authorised to access secure areas with expiry dates.

evidence_requirements.name: Secure Area Entry/Exit Log
evidence_requirements.description: Log entries showing supervised and time-bound access.

evidence_requirements.name: Periodic Inspection Records
evidence_requirements.description: Inspection records showing vacant secure areas are locked and verified.

evidence_requirements.name: Visitor Escort Records
evidence_requirements.description: Records of escorts assigned for visits into secure areas.

evidence_requirements.name: Camera/Photography Prohibition Signage
evidence_requirements.description: Photos of signage prohibiting photography/recording in secure areas.

controls.title: Clear Desk and Clear Screen
controls.description: Clear desk rules for papers and removable storage media and clear screen rules for information processing facilities shall be defined and appropriately enforced.
controls.full_text: Clear desk rules for papers and removable storage media and clear screen rules for information processing facilities shall be defined and appropriately enforced. Information left on desks and screens is likely to be damaged or destroyed in a disaster or accessed by unauthorized persons. Sensitive or critical business information should be locked away when not required. Computers and terminals should be left logged off or protected with a screen lock when unattended.

evidence_requirements.name: Clear Desk and Clear Screen Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Policy with requirements, timing rules and enforcement mechanisms.

evidence_requirements.name: Screen Lock Policy Configuration
evidence_requirements.description: GPO/MDM configuration enforcing auto-lock and screen timeout.

evidence_requirements.name: Clear Desk Walkthrough Audit Results
evidence_requirements.description: Results of periodic walkthrough audits showing compliance rate and findings.

evidence_requirements.name: Lockable Storage Provision Evidence
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence that all staff have access to lockable drawers/cabinets.

evidence_requirements.name: Secure Disposal Bin Placement Map
evidence_requirements.description: Map showing confidential waste bin locations throughout facilities.

evidence_requirements.name: Awareness Material - Clear Desk
evidence_requirements.description: Posters, signage and training content on clear desk/screen rules.

controls.title: Equipment Siting and Protection
controls.description: Equipment shall be sited securely and protected to reduce the risks from physical and environmental threats, and opportunities for unauthorized access.
controls.full_text: Equipment shall be sited securely and protected. Equipment should be sited to reduce unnecessary access into work areas. Information processing facilities handling sensitive data should be positioned to reduce the risk of information being viewed by unauthorized persons during use. Storage facilities should be secured to avoid unauthorized access. Items requiring special protection should be isolated to reduce the general level of protection required.

evidence_requirements.name: Equipment Siting Standards
evidence_requirements.description: Standards for positioning critical equipment away from entrances, windows, water sources.

evidence_requirements.name: Data Center Layout Diagram
evidence_requirements.description: Data centre rack layout with cooling, power, access paths documented.

evidence_requirements.name: Screen Privacy Measures
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of privacy filters, partitions or room layout preventing shoulder surfing.

evidence_requirements.name: Equipment Environmental Controls
evidence_requirements.description: Documentation of cooling, humidity and dust controls for equipment.

evidence_requirements.name: Rack Security Documentation
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of locked racks, rack-level access controls and seals.

evidence_requirements.name: Equipment Protection Risk Assessment
evidence_requirements.description: Risk assessment driving protection choices for specific equipment locations.

controls.title: Security of Assets Off-Premises
controls.description: Off-site assets shall be protected taking into account the different risks of working outside the organization's premises.
controls.full_text: Off-site assets shall be protected. Security measures should be applied to off-site assets taking into account the different risks of working outside the organization's premises. Regardless of ownership, the use of information processing equipment outside the organization's premises should be authorized by management. Equipment and media taken off-premises should not be left unattended in public places. Manufacturer's instructions for protecting equipment should be observed at all times.

evidence_requirements.name: Off-Premises Asset Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Policy governing use of assets outside organisation premises.

evidence_requirements.name: Asset Checkout Log
evidence_requirements.description: Log of assets checked out for off-site use with expected return.

evidence_requirements.name: Management Authorisation Records
evidence_requirements.description: Records showing management approval for off-site equipment use.

evidence_requirements.name: Off-Site Equipment Insurance
evidence_requirements.description: Insurance policy covering equipment used off-premises.

evidence_requirements.name: Travel Security Guidelines
evidence_requirements.description: Guidance for staff travelling with devices, including country-specific advice.

evidence_requirements.name: Loss/Theft Incident Log
evidence_requirements.description: Log of off-site asset loss/theft incidents and response actions.

controls.title: Storage Media
controls.description: Storage media shall be managed through their lifecycle of acquisition, use, transportation, and disposal in accordance with the organization's classification scheme and handling requirements.
controls.full_text: Storage media shall be managed through their lifecycle of acquisition, use, transportation, and disposal in accordance with the organization's classification scheme and handling requirements. Media containing information should be protected against unauthorized access, misuse, or corruption during transportation. Formal procedures for the management of removable media should be implemented. Media that are no longer required should be disposed of securely using formal procedures.

evidence_requirements.name: Removable Media Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Policy on approved media types, encryption, registration and disposal.

evidence_requirements.name: Media Inventory Register
evidence_requirements.description: Register of all managed removable media with owner, classification and status.

evidence_requirements.name: Media Transportation Procedure
evidence_requirements.description: Procedure for secure transport of media (tamper-evident, courier, chain of custody).

evidence_requirements.name: Media Encryption Configuration
evidence_requirements.description: DLP/endpoint configuration enforcing encryption on removable media.

evidence_requirements.name: Media Disposal Records
evidence_requirements.description: Records of secure media destruction including certificates from disposal vendor.

evidence_requirements.name: Removable Media Restriction Evidence
evidence_requirements.description: Endpoint policy evidence restricting USB use to approved devices only.

controls.title: Supporting Utilities
controls.description: Information processing facilities shall be protected from power failures and other disruptions caused by failures in supporting utilities.
controls.full_text: Information processing facilities shall be protected from power failures and other disruptions caused by failures in supporting utilities. Equipment should be protected from power failures and other disruptions caused by failures in supporting utilities such as electricity, telecommunications, water supply, gas, sewage, ventilation, and air conditioning. UPS systems, generators, and redundant utility connections should be implemented for critical systems.

evidence_requirements.name: Utility Support Risk Assessment
evidence_requirements.description: Assessment of dependencies on power, telecoms, HVAC and water.

evidence_requirements.name: UPS Maintenance Records
evidence_requirements.description: Maintenance, battery replacement and load test records for UPS systems.

evidence_requirements.name: Generator Test and Fuel Log
evidence_requirements.description: Records of generator test runs, fuel levels and refueling contracts.

evidence_requirements.name: Dual-Feed Power Documentation
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of diverse utility feeds or PDU redundancy in critical facilities.

evidence_requirements.name: HVAC and Environmental Controls Records
evidence_requirements.description: HVAC maintenance records and environmental monitoring logs.

evidence_requirements.name: Utility SLA and Contracts
evidence_requirements.description: Service level agreements with utility providers.

controls.title: Cabling Security
controls.description: Cables carrying power, data, or supporting information services shall be protected from interception, interference, or damage.
controls.full_text: Cables carrying power, data, or supporting information services shall be protected from interception, interference, or damage. Power and telecommunications cabling carrying data or supporting information services should be protected from interception, interference, or damage. Cables should be protected using conduits or routes that avoid areas accessible to the public. Power cables should be segregated from communications cables to prevent interference. Cable access points should be controlled.

evidence_requirements.name: Cabling Infrastructure Diagram
evidence_requirements.description: Diagrams of power, data and telco cabling paths and patch panels.

evidence_requirements.name: Cable Protection Specifications
evidence_requirements.description: Specs for conduits, armoured cables, separation of power and data.

evidence_requirements.name: Cable Pathway Inspection Report
evidence_requirements.description: Inspection report of cable pathways for damage, interception risk and housekeeping.

evidence_requirements.name: Structured Cabling Certification
evidence_requirements.description: Installer certification of structured cabling installation and testing.

evidence_requirements.name: Cable Labelling Photos
evidence_requirements.description: Photos showing proper cable labelling and documentation at patch panels.

evidence_requirements.name: Cable Access Point Security
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence that cable access points (risers, closets) are locked and monitored.

controls.title: Equipment Maintenance
controls.description: Equipment shall be maintained correctly to ensure availability, integrity, and continued confidentiality of information.
controls.full_text: Equipment shall be maintained correctly to ensure availability, integrity, and continued confidentiality of information. Equipment should be maintained in accordance with the supplier's recommended service intervals and specifications. Only authorized maintenance personnel should carry out repairs and service equipment. Records of all suspected or actual faults and all preventive and corrective maintenance should be kept. Appropriate controls should be implemented when equipment is scheduled for maintenance.

evidence_requirements.name: Equipment Maintenance Schedule
evidence_requirements.description: Planned maintenance schedule covering all critical equipment with intervals.

evidence_requirements.name: Maintenance Work Order History
evidence_requirements.description: History of work orders showing preventive and corrective maintenance performed.

evidence_requirements.name: Authorised Maintenance Personnel List
evidence_requirements.description: List of approved internal and vendor engineers permitted to maintain equipment.

evidence_requirements.name: Maintenance Supervision Records
evidence_requirements.description: Records showing vendor engineers supervised while on site.

evidence_requirements.name: Warranty and Support Contracts
evidence_requirements.description: Active support agreements with OEMs for critical equipment.

evidence_requirements.name: Data Sanitisation Before Maintenance Records
evidence_requirements.description: Records showing sensitive data removed or protected before equipment leaves for repair.

controls.title: Secure Disposal or Re-Use of Equipment
controls.description: Items of equipment containing storage media shall be verified to ensure that any sensitive data and licensed software has been removed or securely overwritten prior to disposal or re-use.
controls.full_text: Items of equipment containing storage media shall be verified to ensure that any sensitive data and licensed software has been removed or securely overwritten prior to disposal or re-use. Prior to disposal or re-use, equipment containing storage media should be checked to ensure that any sensitive data and licensed software has been removed or overwritten. Controls should include physical destruction, secure erasure using approved methods, or encryption with secure key disposal. Certificates of destruction should be obtained.

evidence_requirements.name: Equipment Disposal Procedure
evidence_requirements.description: Procedure for secure disposal, reuse and destruction of equipment with storage.

evidence_requirements.name: Data Sanitisation Records
evidence_requirements.description: Records showing method used (overwrite/degauss/destroy) per device.

evidence_requirements.name: Certificates of Destruction
evidence_requirements.description: Certificates from disposal vendors confirming secure destruction.

evidence_requirements.name: Disposal Vendor Due Diligence
evidence_requirements.description: Assessment of disposal vendor's certifications (e.g., NAID AAA, R2).

evidence_requirements.name: Asset Retirement Workflow Screenshot
evidence_requirements.description: Screenshot of ITAM workflow showing retirement steps and approvals.

evidence_requirements.name: Reuse Approval Records
evidence_requirements.description: Records approving internal reuse after wipe with verification.

evidence_requirements.name: Software License Reclamation Log
evidence_requirements.description: Log of software licenses reclaimed from decommissioned equipment.

controls.title: User Endpoint Devices
controls.description: Information stored on, processed by, or accessible via user endpoint devices shall be protected.
controls.full_text: Information stored on, processed by, or accessible via user endpoint devices shall be protected. A policy on the secure configuration and handling of user endpoint devices should be established. Controls should include device encryption, malware protection, remote wipe capability, screen lock, software restriction policies, and patch management. Mobile device management (MDM) solutions should be implemented to enforce security policies.

evidence_requirements.name: Endpoint Security Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Policy covering configuration, encryption, malware protection and remote wipe for endpoints.

evidence_requirements.name: MDM/UEM Enrolment Report
evidence_requirements.description: Report from Intune/Workspace ONE/Jamf showing enrolled devices vs workforce count.

evidence_requirements.name: Endpoint Encryption Status Report
evidence_requirements.description: BitLocker/FileVault encryption coverage report for all managed endpoints.

evidence_requirements.name: Endpoint Hardening Baseline
evidence_requirements.description: CIS/organisation baseline applied to Windows/macOS/Linux endpoints.

evidence_requirements.name: EDR Deployment Evidence
evidence_requirements.description: EDR (CrowdStrike, Defender, SentinelOne) coverage and policy screenshots.

evidence_requirements.name: Mobile Device Policy Configuration
evidence_requirements.description: MDM compliance policies (passcode, jailbreak detection, app restrictions).

evidence_requirements.name: Lost Device Wipe Log
evidence_requirements.description: Log of remote wipe actions performed on lost/stolen devices.

controls.title: Privileged Access Rights
controls.description: The allocation and use of privileged access rights shall be restricted and managed.
controls.full_text: The allocation and use of privileged access rights shall be restricted and managed. Privileged access rights should be allocated to users on a need-to-use basis and on an event-by-event basis aligned with the access control policy. An authorization process and a record of all privileges allocated should be maintained. Privileged access rights should not be granted until the authorization process is complete. Requirements for expiry of privileged access rights should be defined.

evidence_requirements.name: Privileged Access Management Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Policy defining privileged access definitions, provisioning and oversight.

evidence_requirements.name: Privileged Account Inventory
evidence_requirements.description: Inventory of all privileged accounts with owner, purpose and review date.

evidence_requirements.name: PAM Vault Configuration Screenshot
evidence_requirements.description: CyberArk/BeyondTrust/Delinea configuration showing safes, policies and approvers.

evidence_requirements.name: Privileged Access Request Log
evidence_requirements.description: JIT/approval log for privileged session requests with approvers and durations.

evidence_requirements.name: Privileged Session Recordings
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of session recording enabled on privileged sessions (sample thumbnails).

evidence_requirements.name: Privileged Access Review Records
evidence_requirements.description: Quarterly reviews of privileged accounts with sign-off by system owners.

evidence_requirements.name: Break-Glass Account Procedure
evidence_requirements.description: Documented emergency access procedure with usage monitoring.

controls.title: Information Access Restriction
controls.description: Access to information and other associated assets shall be restricted in accordance with the established topic-specific policy on access control.
controls.full_text: Access to information and other associated assets shall be restricted in accordance with the established topic-specific policy on access control. Access restrictions should be based on individual business application requirements and in accordance with the defined access control policy. Access control mechanisms should restrict access to information, application system functions, and data based on the principle of least privilege and need-to-know.

evidence_requirements.name: Application Access Control Matrix
evidence_requirements.description: Matrix of permissions per role in each business application.

evidence_requirements.name: Data Access Restriction Configuration
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of row/column-level security in databases or data platforms.

evidence_requirements.name: Least Privilege Assessment
evidence_requirements.description: Periodic assessment identifying over-privileged accounts with remediation actions.

evidence_requirements.name: Application Access Review Records
evidence_requirements.description: User access review outputs per application signed off by business owners.

evidence_requirements.name: Access Decision Audit Log
evidence_requirements.description: Log from access management system showing granted/denied decisions.

evidence_requirements.name: Attribute-Based Access Control Configuration
evidence_requirements.description: ABAC policy configuration (e.g., in cloud IAM) with attributes and rules.

controls.title: Access to Source Code
controls.description: Read and write access to source code, development tools, and software libraries shall be appropriately managed.
controls.full_text: Read and write access to source code, development tools, and software libraries shall be appropriately managed. Access to program source code and associated items should be tightly controlled to prevent the introduction of unauthorized functionality, to avoid unintentional changes, and to maintain confidentiality of valuable intellectual property. Source code should be stored in a secured repository with access controls, version management, and audit logging.

evidence_requirements.name: Source Code Access Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Policy governing read/write access to repositories and build systems.

evidence_requirements.name: Repository Access Report
evidence_requirements.description: GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket export showing repo members and permissions.

evidence_requirements.name: Branch Protection Configuration
evidence_requirements.description: Screenshots of branch protection rules (required reviews, status checks).

evidence_requirements.name: Repository Audit Log
evidence_requirements.description: Audit log showing access, pushes, merges and setting changes.

evidence_requirements.name: Code Signing Certificate Management
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of code signing certificates in HSM with restricted access.

evidence_requirements.name: Secrets Scanning Configuration
evidence_requirements.description: Configuration of secrets scanning in repos (e.g., GitHub Advanced Security, TruffleHog).

evidence_requirements.name: Developer Onboarding/Offboarding Log
evidence_requirements.description: Log of developer account creation and removal aligned to employment status.

controls.title: Secure Authentication
controls.description: Secure authentication technologies and procedures shall be established and implemented based on information access restrictions and the topic-specific policy on access control.
controls.full_text: Secure authentication technologies and procedures shall be established and implemented based on information access restrictions and the topic-specific policy on access control. Authentication procedures should include multi-factor authentication for critical systems, protection of authentication information during transmission, and secure storage of authentication credentials. Authentication mechanisms should be appropriate to the sensitivity of the information or system being accessed.

evidence_requirements.name: Authentication Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Policy specifying authentication strengths per risk tier and use cases.

evidence_requirements.name: MFA Coverage Report
evidence_requirements.description: Report showing MFA enforcement across applications and user groups.

evidence_requirements.name: Conditional Access Policy Export
evidence_requirements.description: Export of conditional/step-up access policies from IdP.

evidence_requirements.name: Authentication Protocol Configuration
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of secure protocols (SAML, OIDC, FIDO2) and deprecated protocols disabled.

evidence_requirements.name: Failed Authentication Monitoring
evidence_requirements.description: SIEM dashboard or report showing failed authentication anomaly alerts.

evidence_requirements.name: Biometric/Passwordless Rollout Evidence
evidence_requirements.description: Rollout metrics for FIDO2/WebAuthn/biometric authentication where applicable.

evidence_requirements.name: Authentication Mechanism Review Report
evidence_requirements.description: Periodic review of authentication strength vs. threat landscape.

controls.title: Capacity Management
controls.description: The use of resources shall be monitored and adjusted in line with current and expected capacity requirements.
controls.full_text: The use of resources shall be monitored and adjusted in line with current and expected capacity requirements. Capacity demands should be identified taking into account the business criticality of the system concerned. System tuning and monitoring should be applied to ensure and improve the availability and efficiency of systems. Detective controls should be put in place to indicate problems in due time. Projections of future capacity requirements should take account of new business and system requirements.

evidence_requirements.name: Capacity Management Plan
evidence_requirements.description: Plan covering current and forecast capacity for critical resources.

evidence_requirements.name: Capacity Monitoring Dashboard
evidence_requirements.description: Screenshot of monitoring dashboard (Grafana/Datadog) tracking CPU, memory, storage, bandwidth.

evidence_requirements.name: Capacity Trend Report
evidence_requirements.description: Trend report showing utilisation over time and projected breach points.

evidence_requirements.name: Capacity Alert Configuration
evidence_requirements.description: Alert thresholds configured for capacity metrics with escalation paths.

evidence_requirements.name: Capacity Incident Log
evidence_requirements.description: Log of capacity-related incidents and mitigation actions taken.

evidence_requirements.name: Scaling Test Results
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of load/scaling tests demonstrating ability to meet forecast demand.

controls.title: Protection Against Malware
controls.description: Protection against malware shall be implemented and supported by appropriate user awareness.
controls.full_text: Protection against malware shall be implemented and supported by appropriate user awareness. Detection, prevention, and recovery controls to protect against malware should be implemented, combined with appropriate user awareness. Anti-malware software should be installed and regularly updated. Systems should be regularly scanned for malware. Procedures should address the protection of systems from malware arriving through electronic communications, the internet, and removable media.

evidence_requirements.name: Malware Protection Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Policy covering anti-malware controls across endpoints, servers, email and web.

evidence_requirements.name: Anti-Malware/EDR Coverage Report
evidence_requirements.description: Report showing anti-malware agent installed on all managed devices.

evidence_requirements.name: Signature/Definition Update Status
evidence_requirements.description: Status showing all endpoints have current definitions/engine versions.

evidence_requirements.name: Malware Detection and Response Log
evidence_requirements.description: Log of malware detected, quarantined and incidents opened.

evidence_requirements.name: Email Anti-Malware Scanning Report
evidence_requirements.description: Report from email security gateway showing malware blocked.

evidence_requirements.name: User Awareness Training - Malware Module
evidence_requirements.description: Training records on recognising and avoiding malware.

evidence_requirements.name: Removable Media AV Scan Configuration
evidence_requirements.description: Endpoint configuration enforcing AV scan on USB insert.

controls.title: Management of Technical Vulnerabilities
controls.description: Information about technical vulnerabilities of information systems in use shall be obtained in a timely fashion, the organization's exposure to such vulnerabilities shall be evaluated, and appropriate measures shall be taken.
controls.full_text: Information about technical vulnerabilities of information systems in use shall be obtained in a timely fashion, the organization's exposure to such vulnerabilities shall be evaluated, and appropriate measures shall be taken. A timely response to the identification of potential technical vulnerabilities should be ensured. Vulnerability scans should be performed regularly. Patches should be tested and evaluated before they are installed. A current and complete inventory of assets is a prerequisite for effective technical vulnerability management.

evidence_requirements.name: Vulnerability Management Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Policy covering scanning cadence, SLAs, prioritisation and exception handling.

evidence_requirements.name: Vulnerability Scanning Reports
evidence_requirements.description: Periodic scan reports from Tenable/Qualys/Rapid7 covering internal and external assets.

evidence_requirements.name: Patch Management Records
evidence_requirements.description: Records of patches deployed per system with success/failure and rollback.

evidence_requirements.name: Vulnerability Remediation Tracker
evidence_requirements.description: Tracker showing open vulnerabilities, owners, SLAs and closure status.

evidence_requirements.name: Penetration Test Reports
evidence_requirements.description: Annual penetration test reports with findings and remediation evidence.

evidence_requirements.name: Vulnerability SLA Compliance Report
evidence_requirements.description: Metrics showing remediation performance against SLA by severity.

evidence_requirements.name: Risk Acceptance Records
evidence_requirements.description: Documented acceptance of vulnerabilities that cannot be remediated immediately.

controls.title: Configuration Management
controls.description: Configurations, including security configurations, of hardware, software, services, and networks shall be established, documented, implemented, monitored, and reviewed.
controls.full_text: Configurations, including security configurations, of hardware, software, services, and networks shall be established, documented, implemented, monitored, and reviewed. This is a new control in ISO 27001:2022. Standard configuration templates should be defined for hardware, software, services, and networks. Configuration changes should be controlled through the change management process. Configurations should be monitored and any deviations from the approved baseline should be detected and addressed.

evidence_requirements.name: Configuration Management Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Policy defining configuration standards, baselines and change controls.

evidence_requirements.name: Configuration Baseline Documentation
evidence_requirements.description: Baseline configurations (CIS, STIG, internal) for each platform in use.

evidence_requirements.name: Configuration Compliance Scan Report
evidence_requirements.description: Compliance scan results vs. baselines (e.g., Tenable.sc, Chef InSpec, AWS Config).

evidence_requirements.name: Infrastructure-as-Code Repositories
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of IaC repos (Terraform, Ansible) enforcing configuration consistency.

evidence_requirements.name: Configuration Drift Alerts
evidence_requirements.description: Alert configuration and examples of drift detected and remediated.

evidence_requirements.name: Hardening Sign-off Records
evidence_requirements.description: Sign-off records for systems before production deployment confirming baseline applied.

evidence_requirements.name: Golden Image Documentation
evidence_requirements.description: Documentation of approved golden images for servers and workstations.

controls.title: Information Deletion
controls.description: Information stored in information systems, devices, or in any other storage media shall be deleted when no longer required.
controls.full_text: Information stored in information systems, devices, or in any other storage media shall be deleted when no longer required. This is a new control in ISO 27001:2022. Deletion methods should be appropriate to the sensitivity of the information. Deletion should comply with applicable legal and regulatory requirements. Records of deletion should be maintained. Deletion should include information in cloud services, backup media, and all copies.

evidence_requirements.name: Information Deletion Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Policy defining when and how information must be deleted from systems.

evidence_requirements.name: Retention and Deletion Schedule
evidence_requirements.description: Schedule defining retention periods by data category and deletion triggers.

evidence_requirements.name: Deletion Procedure Documentation
evidence_requirements.description: Procedures for secure deletion across different systems (DB, file, cloud, backup).

evidence_requirements.name: Data Deletion Records
evidence_requirements.description: Log of deletions executed per retention schedule with verification.

evidence_requirements.name: Cloud Provider Deletion Attestations
evidence_requirements.description: Attestations from cloud providers confirming data deletion on termination.

evidence_requirements.name: Backup Deletion Records
evidence_requirements.description: Records showing expired backups have been purged from media.

evidence_requirements.name: Right to Erasure Fulfilment Log
evidence_requirements.description: Log of GDPR/privacy erasure requests fulfilled and verified.

controls.title: Data Masking
controls.description: Data masking shall be used in accordance with the organization's topic-specific policy on access control and other related topic-specific policies, and business requirements, taking applicable legislation into consideration.
controls.full_text: Data masking shall be used in accordance with the organization's topic-specific policy on access control and other related topic-specific policies, and business requirements, taking applicable legislation into consideration. This is a new control in ISO 27001:2022. Data masking techniques such as anonymization, pseudonymization, tokenization, and redaction should be applied to protect sensitive data in non-production environments and to comply with privacy requirements.

evidence_requirements.name: Data Masking Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Policy defining when anonymisation, pseudonymisation, tokenisation or redaction are required.

evidence_requirements.name: Masking Rules Specification
evidence_requirements.description: Masking rules specifying fields, techniques and environments.

evidence_requirements.name: Masking Tool Configuration
evidence_requirements.description: Screenshot of configuration for masking tools (Delphix, Informatica, custom).

evidence_requirements.name: Non-Production Data Extract Verification
evidence_requirements.description: Sample extract from non-prod confirming sensitive data is masked.

evidence_requirements.name: Tokenisation Vault Configuration
evidence_requirements.description: Configuration of tokenisation vault for payment or PII data.

evidence_requirements.name: Masking Review and Sign-off
evidence_requirements.description: Review by data owner confirming masking is adequate for intended use.

controls.title: Data Leakage Prevention
controls.description: Data leakage prevention measures shall be applied to systems, networks, and any other devices that process, store, or transmit sensitive information.
controls.full_text: Data leakage prevention measures shall be applied to systems, networks, and any other devices that process, store, or transmit sensitive information. This is a new control in ISO 27001:2022. DLP measures should monitor and control information flows to prevent unauthorized disclosure of sensitive information. DLP tools should be configured to detect and prevent data exfiltration through email, web uploads, removable media, and other channels. Alerts should be generated and investigated when potential data leakage is detected.

evidence_requirements.name: Data Leakage Prevention Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Policy defining scope, detection strategy and response for DLP.

evidence_requirements.name: DLP Tool Ruleset Export
evidence_requirements.description: Export of DLP rules covering email, endpoint, web and cloud channels.

evidence_requirements.name: DLP Alert and Investigation Log
evidence_requirements.description: Log of DLP alerts triggered, triaged and investigated.

evidence_requirements.name: DLP Dashboard Screenshot
evidence_requirements.description: DLP platform dashboard (e.g., Purview, Symantec, Forcepoint) showing coverage.

evidence_requirements.name: USB/Removable Media Control Configuration
evidence_requirements.description: Endpoint control preventing/monitoring data transfers to removable media.

evidence_requirements.name: Cloud DLP Configuration
evidence_requirements.description: Configuration of DLP for cloud storage (Google Drive, OneDrive, Box).

evidence_requirements.name: DLP Incident Response Playbook
evidence_requirements.description: Playbook defining response steps for confirmed data leakage events.

controls.title: Information Backup
controls.description: Backup copies of information, software, and systems shall be maintained and regularly tested in accordance with the agreed topic-specific policy on backup.
controls.full_text: Backup copies of information, software, and systems shall be maintained and regularly tested in accordance with the agreed topic-specific policy on backup. The backup policy should define the organization's requirements for backup of information, software, and systems. The backup policy should define retention and protection requirements. Adequate backup facilities should be provided to ensure that all essential information and software can be recovered following a disaster or media failure. Restoration procedures should be regularly tested.

evidence_requirements.name: Backup Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Policy defining scope, frequency, retention, encryption and testing for backups.

evidence_requirements.name: Backup Schedule and Configuration
evidence_requirements.description: Configuration from backup tool (Veeam, Commvault, native cloud) showing jobs and retention.

evidence_requirements.name: Backup Success/Failure Report
evidence_requirements.description: Periodic report showing backup job status and failure remediation.

evidence_requirements.name: Backup Restoration Test Results
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of periodic restore tests with success criteria and outcomes.

evidence_requirements.name: Offsite/Immutable Backup Evidence
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of offsite replication or immutable/object-lock backup copies (3-2-1 rule).

evidence_requirements.name: Backup Encryption Configuration
evidence_requirements.description: Configuration showing backups encrypted at rest and in transit.

evidence_requirements.name: Backup Inventory and Catalogue
evidence_requirements.description: Catalogue of backup sets and media with verification hashes.

controls.title: Redundancy of Information Processing Facilities
controls.description: Information processing facilities shall be implemented with sufficient redundancy to meet availability requirements.
controls.full_text: Information processing facilities shall be implemented with sufficient redundancy to meet availability requirements. The organization should identify the business requirements for availability of information systems. Where availability cannot be guaranteed using the existing systems architecture, redundant components or architectures should be considered. Redundant information processing facilities should be tested to ensure that failover from one component to another works as intended.

evidence_requirements.name: Availability Requirements Register
evidence_requirements.description: Register of services and their availability targets (e.g., 99.9%, tier class).

evidence_requirements.name: Redundant Architecture Documentation
evidence_requirements.description: Architecture diagrams showing redundancy (clusters, load balancers, multi-AZ/region).

evidence_requirements.name: High Availability Configuration Screenshots
evidence_requirements.description: Screenshots of HA configurations (database clusters, F5, cloud ASGs).

evidence_requirements.name: Failover Test Results
evidence_requirements.description: Results of failover tests showing RTO attainment.

evidence_requirements.name: Uptime/SLA Report
evidence_requirements.description: Monthly report of service uptime against SLA commitments.

evidence_requirements.name: Single Points of Failure Analysis
evidence_requirements.description: Analysis of SPOFs with mitigation plans.

controls.title: Logging
controls.description: Logs that record activities, exceptions, faults, and other relevant events shall be produced, stored, protected, and analyzed.
controls.full_text: Logs that record activities, exceptions, faults, and other relevant events shall be produced, stored, protected, and analyzed. Event logs recording user activities, exceptions, faults, and information security events should be produced, kept, and regularly reviewed. Log facilities and log information should be protected against tampering and unauthorized access. System administrator and system operator activities should be logged and the logs protected and regularly reviewed.

evidence_requirements.name: Logging Policy and Standards
evidence_requirements.description: Policy defining what to log, retention, protection and review requirements.

evidence_requirements.name: Log Source Inventory
evidence_requirements.description: Inventory of log sources covered, frequency and retention per source.

evidence_requirements.name: SIEM Ingestion Dashboard
evidence_requirements.description: SIEM dashboard (Splunk, Sentinel, Elastic) showing log ingestion health.

evidence_requirements.name: Log Protection Configuration
evidence_requirements.description: Configuration showing log tamper protection, append-only and access controls.

evidence_requirements.name: Privileged Activity Log Review Records
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of periodic review of admin/privileged activity logs.

evidence_requirements.name: Log Retention Configuration
evidence_requirements.description: Retention rules configured in log archive (e.g., cold storage, immutable).

evidence_requirements.name: Log Anomaly Alerting Configuration
evidence_requirements.description: Configuration of alerts on log gaps or logging service disruption.

controls.title: Monitoring Activities
controls.description: Networks, systems, and applications shall be monitored for anomalous behaviour and appropriate actions taken to evaluate potential information security incidents.
controls.full_text: Networks, systems, and applications shall be monitored for anomalous behaviour and appropriate actions taken to evaluate potential information security incidents. This is a new control in ISO 27001:2022. Monitoring should include real-time analysis of security events, network traffic analysis, system performance monitoring, and application behavior monitoring. SIEM solutions should be implemented to correlate events and detect potential security incidents. Automated alerts should be configured for critical security events.

evidence_requirements.name: Security Monitoring Strategy
evidence_requirements.description: Strategy document defining SOC scope, coverage and detection goals.

evidence_requirements.name: SIEM Use-Case Library
evidence_requirements.description: Catalogue of detection use cases mapped to MITRE ATT&CK.

evidence_requirements.name: SOC Runbook/Playbooks
evidence_requirements.description: Playbooks for responding to specific alert types.

evidence_requirements.name: Detection Alert Tuning Log
evidence_requirements.description: Log of detection rule changes and tuning actions over time.

evidence_requirements.name: Monitoring Coverage Report
evidence_requirements.description: Report showing monitoring coverage across environments and assets.

evidence_requirements.name: SOC Shift Handover Records
evidence_requirements.description: Shift handover documentation showing continuous monitoring.

evidence_requirements.name: Threat Hunting Reports
evidence_requirements.description: Proactive threat hunting engagement reports with findings.

controls.title: Clock Synchronization
controls.description: The clocks of information processing systems used by the organization shall be synchronized to approved time sources.
controls.full_text: The clocks of information processing systems used by the organization shall be synchronized to approved time sources. All relevant information processing systems within the organization or security domain should be synchronized with an approved time source. The use of Network Time Protocol (NTP) or equivalent should be established to synchronize all clocks. Accurate clock settings are important to ensure the accuracy of audit logs, which may be required for investigations or as evidence in legal or disciplinary cases.

evidence_requirements.name: Time Synchronisation Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Policy mandating NTP and approved time sources across all systems.

evidence_requirements.name: NTP Configuration Export
evidence_requirements.description: NTP configuration export from domain controllers, servers and network devices.

evidence_requirements.name: Time Source Authority Documentation
evidence_requirements.description: Documentation of primary and secondary NTP sources used (e.g., stratum 1 servers).

evidence_requirements.name: Time Drift Monitoring Report
evidence_requirements.description: Monitoring report showing clock offset across systems stays within tolerance.

evidence_requirements.name: Time Sync Verification Script Output
evidence_requirements.description: Output from verification script showing time alignment across sample hosts.

evidence_requirements.name: Time Source Redundancy Design
evidence_requirements.description: Design showing redundant time sources to prevent single point of failure.

controls.title: Use of Privileged Utility Programs
controls.description: The use of utility programs that might be capable of overriding system and application controls shall be restricted and tightly controlled.
controls.full_text: The use of utility programs that might be capable of overriding system and application controls shall be restricted and tightly controlled. The use and installation of utility programs should be restricted and monitored. Utility programs should be identified and controlled. Authorization levels for utility programs should be clearly defined. All use of utility programs should be logged and monitored. Unnecessary utility programs should be removed or disabled.

evidence_requirements.name: Privileged Utility Program Inventory
evidence_requirements.description: Inventory of utilities capable of bypassing controls with approval status.

evidence_requirements.name: Utility Access Control Configuration
evidence_requirements.description: Configuration restricting access to utilities to authorised administrators.

evidence_requirements.name: Utility Usage Log
evidence_requirements.description: Log of utility program executions with user, host, command and timestamp.

evidence_requirements.name: Unnecessary Utility Removal Evidence
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence that unnecessary utilities have been removed from production systems.

evidence_requirements.name: Utility Approval Workflow
evidence_requirements.description: Workflow requiring approval before sensitive utility use.

evidence_requirements.name: Application Allow-List Configuration
evidence_requirements.description: App allow-list (e.g., AppLocker, WDAC) configuration restricting utility execution.

controls.title: Installation of Software on Operational Systems
controls.description: Procedures and measures shall be implemented to securely manage software installation on operational systems.
controls.full_text: Procedures and measures shall be implemented to securely manage software installation on operational systems. The installation of software on operational systems should be controlled. Only authorized and tested software should be installed on operational systems. A software installation policy should define what types of software installations are permitted and what are prohibited. Installation should be performed only by authorized administrators after appropriate testing and approval.

evidence_requirements.name: Software Installation Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Policy on permitted software, installation rights and approval process.

evidence_requirements.name: Approved Software Catalogue
evidence_requirements.description: Catalogue of approved software available via self-service or deployment tools.

evidence_requirements.name: Software Deployment Tool Configuration
evidence_requirements.description: Configuration of SCCM/Intune/Jamf controlling software distribution.

evidence_requirements.name: Non-Admin User Configuration
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence that standard users lack rights to install arbitrary software.

evidence_requirements.name: Installed Software Inventory
evidence_requirements.description: Report comparing installed software against approved catalogue.

evidence_requirements.name: Software Installation Approval Records
evidence_requirements.description: Approval records for non-standard software installation requests.

evidence_requirements.name: Shadow IT Discovery Report
evidence_requirements.description: Report from CASB or discovery tool identifying unauthorised applications.

controls.title: Networks Security
controls.description: Networks and network devices shall be secured, managed, and controlled to protect information in systems and applications.
controls.full_text: Networks and network devices shall be secured, managed, and controlled to protect information in systems and applications. Controls should be implemented to ensure the security of information in networks and the protection of connected services from unauthorized access. Network management responsibilities and procedures should be established. Network controls should include separation of network services, intrusion detection/prevention, and secure configuration of network devices.

evidence_requirements.name: Network Security Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Policy covering network security architecture, controls and operations.

evidence_requirements.name: Network Architecture Diagram
evidence_requirements.description: Current network architecture diagram including security zones and controls.

evidence_requirements.name: Firewall Rule Base Export
evidence_requirements.description: Export of firewall rules for review (source, dest, port, service, description).

evidence_requirements.name: Firewall Ruleset Review Records
evidence_requirements.description: Periodic firewall ruleset review records with justification and cleanup actions.

evidence_requirements.name: Network Device Hardening Standards
evidence_requirements.description: Hardening standards applied to routers, switches, firewalls, WAPs.

evidence_requirements.name: IDS/IPS Configuration and Alerts
evidence_requirements.description: IDS/IPS rule configuration and sample alerts investigated.

evidence_requirements.name: Wireless Network Security Configuration
evidence_requirements.description: WPA3/Enterprise configuration, rogue AP detection and guest network isolation.

controls.title: Security of Network Services
controls.description: Security mechanisms, service levels, and service requirements of network services shall be identified, implemented, and monitored.
controls.full_text: Security mechanisms, service levels, and service requirements of network services shall be identified, implemented, and monitored. The ability of the network service provider to manage agreed services in a secure way should be determined and regularly monitored, and the right to audit should be agreed. Security arrangements necessary for particular services should include security features, service levels, and management requirements. The organization should ensure that network service providers implement these measures.

evidence_requirements.name: Network Service Agreements
evidence_requirements.description: Contracts with ISPs, MPLS and cloud interconnect providers with security terms.

evidence_requirements.name: Network Service Security Specifications
evidence_requirements.description: Documented security features required of each network service (DDoS, MACsec, encryption).

evidence_requirements.name: Service Monitoring Reports
evidence_requirements.description: Monitoring reports showing adherence to agreed service levels and security.

evidence_requirements.name: Provider Audit Reports
evidence_requirements.description: Audit reports or assurance reports received from network service providers.

evidence_requirements.name: VPN/Circuit Encryption Evidence
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of encryption on inter-site circuits and VPNs (IPsec, MACsec).

evidence_requirements.name: Network Service Change Log
evidence_requirements.description: Log of changes to network services and security impact assessments.

controls.title: Segregation of Networks
controls.description: Groups of information services, users, and information systems shall be segregated in the organization's networks.
controls.full_text: Groups of information services, users, and information systems shall be segregated in the organization's networks. Large networks should be divided into separate network domains. Network segmentation should be based on the risk assessment and the trust level, criticality, and sensitivity of information systems. Wireless networks should be segregated from internal networks. Network access between domains should be controlled using gateways (e.g., firewalls, routers) with appropriate filtering rules.

evidence_requirements.name: Network Segmentation Design
evidence_requirements.description: Segmentation design document with VLANs, subnets, zones and trust levels.

evidence_requirements.name: VLAN and Subnet Register
evidence_requirements.description: Register of VLANs/subnets with purpose, owners and allowed traffic.

evidence_requirements.name: Inter-Zone Firewall Rules
evidence_requirements.description: Firewall rules governing traffic between network zones.

evidence_requirements.name: Segmentation Test Results
evidence_requirements.description: Results of segmentation penetration tests verifying isolation effectiveness.

evidence_requirements.name: Microsegmentation Configuration
evidence_requirements.description: Microsegmentation configuration (NSX, Illumio, cloud security groups).

evidence_requirements.name: Wireless Segregation Evidence
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence that guest and corporate wireless networks are segregated.

evidence_requirements.name: OT/IT Segmentation Documentation
evidence_requirements.description: Documentation of segmentation between OT/ICS and corporate networks where applicable.

controls.title: Web Filtering
controls.description: Access to external websites shall be managed to reduce exposure to malicious content.
controls.full_text: Access to external websites shall be managed to reduce exposure to malicious content. This is a new control in ISO 27001:2022. The organization should implement web filtering to block access to malicious websites, inappropriate content, and potential data exfiltration channels. Web filtering should be regularly updated to address emerging threats. Web access logs should be monitored and analyzed. Users should be educated about safe web browsing practices.

evidence_requirements.name: Web Filtering Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Policy defining prohibited categories and enforcement points.

evidence_requirements.name: Web Filtering Rule Configuration
evidence_requirements.description: Configuration of category-based blocking from proxy/SSE (e.g., Zscaler, Netskope, Umbrella).

evidence_requirements.name: Web Access Log Sample
evidence_requirements.description: Web proxy log showing allowed/blocked requests for sample periods.

evidence_requirements.name: Blocked Site Investigation Records
evidence_requirements.description: Records of investigations into blocked-site hits suggesting malicious activity.

evidence_requirements.name: Web Filter Exception Register
evidence_requirements.description: Register of approved exceptions with expiry and justification.

evidence_requirements.name: DNS Filtering Configuration
evidence_requirements.description: DNS filtering configuration blocking known malicious domains.

evidence_requirements.name: Safe Browsing Awareness Material
evidence_requirements.description: Training content teaching staff safe browsing practices.

controls.title: Use of Cryptography
controls.description: Rules for the effective use of cryptography, including cryptographic key management, shall be defined and implemented.
controls.full_text: Rules for the effective use of cryptography, including cryptographic key management, shall be defined and implemented. A policy on the use of cryptographic controls for protection of information should be developed and implemented. Decisions on the appropriate level of cryptographic protection should be based on a risk assessment. Key management should support the use of cryptographic techniques. Appropriate standards should be defined for effective implementation throughout the organization.

evidence_requirements.name: Cryptography Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Policy defining approved algorithms, key lengths, protocols and use cases.

evidence_requirements.name: Cryptographic Standards Document
evidence_requirements.description: Technical standards (e.g., AES-256, TLS 1.3, SHA-256) with deprecation plans.

evidence_requirements.name: Key Management Procedures
evidence_requirements.description: Procedures for key generation, distribution, rotation, escrow and destruction.

evidence_requirements.name: HSM Configuration Documentation
evidence_requirements.description: HSM setup, FIPS certification and operator roles documentation.

evidence_requirements.name: Certificate Inventory
evidence_requirements.description: Inventory of TLS and code-signing certificates with expiry and owners.

evidence_requirements.name: Encryption Coverage Assessment
evidence_requirements.description: Assessment confirming data at rest/in transit encryption across critical systems.

evidence_requirements.name: Key Rotation Log
evidence_requirements.description: Log of cryptographic key rotations performed per schedule.

evidence_requirements.name: Crypto-Agility Plan
evidence_requirements.description: Plan for migration to post-quantum or alternative algorithms.

controls.title: Secure Development Life Cycle
controls.description: Rules for the secure development of software and systems shall be established and applied.
controls.full_text: Rules for the secure development of software and systems shall be established and applied. Secure development guidelines should be in place. Security should be designed and implemented within the development lifecycle of information systems. Rules for development of software and systems should be applied to developments within the organization. Secure coding practices, security testing, and secure deployment procedures should be defined and followed throughout the development lifecycle.

evidence_requirements.name: Secure SDLC Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Policy embedding security activities throughout the development lifecycle.

evidence_requirements.name: SDLC Process Documentation
evidence_requirements.description: Documentation of each SDLC phase with security gates and deliverables.

evidence_requirements.name: Security Requirements Template
evidence_requirements.description: Template used to capture security requirements in user stories/specs.

evidence_requirements.name: Threat Modelling Artifacts
evidence_requirements.description: Threat models (e.g., STRIDE) created during design phase for sample projects.

evidence_requirements.name: Security Review Gate Records
evidence_requirements.description: Records of security gate approvals before release.

evidence_requirements.name: Developer Security Training Records
evidence_requirements.description: Training records for secure coding completion by developers.

evidence_requirements.name: Pipeline Security Configuration
evidence_requirements.description: CI/CD pipeline configuration with embedded security scans (SAST, DAST, SCA).

controls.title: Application Security Requirements
controls.description: Information security requirements shall be identified, specified, and approved when developing or acquiring applications.
controls.full_text: Information security requirements shall be identified, specified, and approved when developing or acquiring applications. Information security related requirements should be included in the requirements for new information systems or enhancements to existing information systems. Security requirements should address authentication, authorization, input validation, output encoding, session management, error handling, and logging. Requirements should be derived from risk assessment and organizational security policies.

evidence_requirements.name: Application Security Requirements Catalogue
evidence_requirements.description: Catalogue of reusable security requirements (ASVS-based) applied to applications.

evidence_requirements.name: Sample Project Security Requirements
evidence_requirements.description: Redacted security requirements specifications from real projects.

evidence_requirements.name: Requirements Sign-off Records
evidence_requirements.description: Records showing security requirements approved by security/architecture.

evidence_requirements.name: Application Risk Assessment
evidence_requirements.description: Risk assessment for each application driving security requirement selection.

evidence_requirements.name: Acquired Software Security Evaluation
evidence_requirements.description: Security evaluation of COTS/SaaS applications before acquisition.

evidence_requirements.name: API Security Requirements Standard
evidence_requirements.description: Standard for API authentication, authorisation, validation and rate limiting.

controls.title: Secure System Architecture and Engineering Principles
controls.description: Principles for engineering secure systems shall be established, documented, maintained, and applied to any information system development activities.
controls.full_text: Principles for engineering secure systems shall be established, documented, maintained, and applied to any information system development activities. Secure system engineering principles should be established, documented, maintained, and applied to any information system implementation efforts. These principles should include defense in depth, least privilege, fail-safe defaults, complete mediation, open design, separation of privilege, least common mechanism, and psychological acceptability.

evidence_requirements.name: Secure Architecture Principles Document
evidence_requirements.description: Documented principles (defence in depth, least privilege, zero trust, etc.).

evidence_requirements.name: Architecture Review Board Records
evidence_requirements.description: ARB minutes showing security review of architectures.

evidence_requirements.name: Reference Architectures
evidence_requirements.description: Reference architectures for common solution patterns with security baked in.

evidence_requirements.name: System Design Documents
evidence_requirements.description: Design documents for sample systems showing application of principles.

evidence_requirements.name: Security Pattern Library
evidence_requirements.description: Library of approved security patterns (auth flows, data protection patterns).

evidence_requirements.name: Architecture Deviation Register
evidence_requirements.description: Register of approved deviations from reference architectures.

controls.title: Secure Coding
controls.description: Secure coding principles shall be applied to software development.
controls.full_text: Secure coding principles shall be applied to software development. This is a new control in ISO 27001:2022. Secure coding practices should address input validation, output encoding, authentication and session management, access control, error handling and logging, data protection, communication security, and secure configuration. Code reviews should be performed to verify compliance with secure coding standards. Static and dynamic application security testing should be conducted.

evidence_requirements.name: Secure Coding Standards
evidence_requirements.description: Organisation secure coding standards by language (e.g., OWASP, CERT).

evidence_requirements.name: Code Review Checklist
evidence_requirements.description: Checklist used in peer code reviews covering security items.

evidence_requirements.name: SAST Scan Reports
evidence_requirements.description: Static application security testing reports per release.

evidence_requirements.name: DAST Scan Reports
evidence_requirements.description: Dynamic application security testing reports for web applications.

evidence_requirements.name: SCA/Dependency Scan Reports
evidence_requirements.description: Software composition analysis reports showing vulnerable dependencies.

evidence_requirements.name: Pull Request Review Evidence
evidence_requirements.description: Sample PRs showing security-related review comments and resolutions.

evidence_requirements.name: Secure Coding Training Records
evidence_requirements.description: Developer training completion records for secure coding modules.

evidence_requirements.name: Build Pipeline Security Gates
evidence_requirements.description: Pipeline configuration breaking builds on critical security findings.

controls.title: Security Testing in Development and Acceptance
controls.description: Security testing processes shall be defined and implemented in the development lifecycle.
controls.full_text: Security testing processes shall be defined and implemented in the development lifecycle. Security testing should include both functional security testing and security vulnerability testing. Testing should be performed in a secure test environment that realistically represents the planned operational environment. New systems, updates, and new versions should be thoroughly tested and verified during development and prior to acceptance and deployment.

evidence_requirements.name: Security Testing Strategy
evidence_requirements.description: Strategy defining testing types and coverage across release cycle.

evidence_requirements.name: Security Test Plans
evidence_requirements.description: Test plans for each release including security test cases.

evidence_requirements.name: Penetration Test Reports
evidence_requirements.description: Penetration test reports prior to major releases with retest verification.

evidence_requirements.name: Security Acceptance Test Results
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of security acceptance testing prior to go-live.

evidence_requirements.name: UAT/Test Environment Documentation
evidence_requirements.description: Documentation of isolated test environments used for security testing.

evidence_requirements.name: Bug Bounty Programme Reports
evidence_requirements.description: Reports from bug bounty platforms (HackerOne, Bugcrowd) with valid findings.

evidence_requirements.name: Retest/Closure Evidence
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of retesting after remediation of security findings.

controls.title: Outsourced Development
controls.description: The organization shall direct, monitor, and review the activities related to outsourced system development.
controls.full_text: The organization shall direct, monitor, and review the activities related to outsourced system development. Where system development is outsourced, the organization should obtain assurances that the supplier's security controls and practices are adequate. Contractual agreements should address intellectual property rights, code quality, security testing requirements, and right to audit. The organization should review and verify the quality and accuracy of outsourced development work.

evidence_requirements.name: Outsourced Development Agreement
evidence_requirements.description: Contracts with development suppliers including security, IP and testing obligations.

evidence_requirements.name: Vendor Secure SDLC Assessment
evidence_requirements.description: Assessment of supplier's SDLC maturity and security practices.

evidence_requirements.name: Code Review of Vendor Deliverables
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence of organisation-side code review of vendor-delivered code.

evidence_requirements.name: Vendor Security Test Results
evidence_requirements.description: Security test results from vendor deliverables (SAST, DAST, penetration).

evidence_requirements.name: Source Code Escrow Agreement
evidence_requirements.description: Source code escrow arrangement for critical outsourced software.

evidence_requirements.name: Vendor Quality Reports

controls.title: Separation of Development, Test, and Production Environments
controls.description: Development, testing, and production environments shall be separated and secured to reduce the risks of unauthorized access or changes to the production environment.
controls.full_text: Development, testing, and production environments shall be separated and secured to reduce the risks of unauthorized access or changes to the production environment. The level of separation between development, testing, and production environments that is necessary to prevent operational problems should be identified and corresponding controls should be implemented. Software should be migrated from development to production through defined and documented procedures.

evidence_requirements.name: Environment Separation Standard
evidence_requirements.description: Standard defining required separation between dev, test and production.

controls.title: Change Management
controls.description: Changes to information processing facilities and information systems shall be subject to change management procedures.
controls.full_text: Changes to information processing facilities and information systems shall be subject to change management procedures. Changes to information systems within the development lifecycle should be controlled by the use of formal change management procedures. Change management procedures should include assessment of potential impacts, approval of changes, communication of change details, testing and validation, rollback procedures, and maintenance of an audit trail of all changes.

controls.title: Test Information
controls.description: Test information shall be appropriately selected, protected, and managed.
controls.full_text: Test information shall be appropriately selected, protected, and managed. The use of operational databases containing personal information or any other sensitive information for testing purposes should be avoided. If personal information or otherwise sensitive information is used for testing purposes, all sensitive details and content should be protected by removal or modification. Data protection procedures should be applied to test data. Operational data should be removed from a test environment immediately after testing is complete.

evidence_requirements.name: Test Data Management Policy

evidence_requirements.name: Test Data Access Controls

evidence_requirements.name: Test Data Deletion Records

evidence_requirements.name: Synthetic Data Generation Procedure
evidence_requirements.description: Procedure for generating synthetic data where real data is unsuitable.

controls.title: Protection of Information Systems During Audit Testing
controls.description: Audit tests and other assurance activities involving assessment of operational systems shall be planned and agreed between the tester and appropriate management.
controls.full_text: Audit tests and other assurance activities involving assessment of operational systems shall be planned and agreed between the tester and appropriate management. Audit requirements and activities involving checks on operational systems should be carefully planned and agreed to minimize the risk of disruptions to business processes. The scope of the agreed technical audit tests should be controlled and limited. Audit tests should be limited to read-only access to software and data where possible.
